Sheikh Russel's Bosnian forward Damir Ibric scored a superb 85th-minute goal vs Sheikh Jamal and another today: 2 goals in 2 matches.

posts.summary: Admin asks members to post long informative feature posts instead of one-liners, recalling great old posts on the Swadhin Bangla team, Monem Munna, Mamunul and Jahid, ahead of the group's first anniversary.
Breaking news: Wales-based Bangladeshi-origin players Akmol (left-back) and Rizwan (right-back) arrive 29 July for trials; BFF has sent them invitations.
Mohammad Jewel, who scored 22 goals in the Pioneer League, will represent Bangladesh U16 at the AFC and SAFF U16 tournaments; poster hopes BFF arranges a Europe trial for him.
Long critical post on how Bangladesh football can progress: proposes a 20-team home-and-away national league and blames BFF inaction and greed.
AFC member association ranking update (24 July 2015): Bangladesh ranked 39th with 3.639 points.

posts.summary: Newspaper report: DFA Monitoring Committee proposes adding district teams from outside Dhaka to the Premier League; BFF member Shamsul Haque Chowdhury says at least two more teams next season.
Rizwan and Akmal are coming to Bangladesh today and will stay with the U19 squad under coach Titu.
Lists the teams participating in the Sheikh Kamal Gold Cup, including Sheikh Jamal, Mohammedan, Abahani, Mohun Bagan or East Bengal, Druk United, Nepal Police Club and hosts Chittagong Abahani.
Poster says only Jamal Bhuyan showed such patriotism before, and believes Akmal and Rizwan have it too.
1st leg Abahani vs Muktijodha ended 0-1; poster asks if Abahani will get revenge in the 2nd leg at 6:30 PM.
Poster quotes ex-footballer Moinuddin Ahmed saying current players are destroying football, then mocks him and defends current players like Emily, Jamal, Mamunul and Hemanta.
World Tiger Day greetings to the Bengal Tigers (cricket team).
Fan asks when the decision on playing foreign/expatriate players in the national team will come, the status of Riasat Islam, and whether Akmol and Rizwan will play for clubs first.
Half-time report: Abahani 0-0 Muktijodha; Enamul looks hungry for a goal and is playing brilliantly.
Live update (68th minute): Enamul scores from a penalty, Abahani 0-1 Muktijodha; praise for goalkeeper Titu's saves.
Sheikh Jamal need 3 points from 3 matches (vs Mohammedan, Abahani, Muktijodha) to become BPL 2014-15 champions.
Fan says Abahani's defence is not good enough to stop Enamul, 'The Beast' / 'The General'.
Quotes from Rizwan Ahmed and Akmol Ali on their inspiration and upcoming trials to play for Bangladesh; poster wishes them luck.
General football-culture post on the history of tango and samba styles, tracing tango to 1890s Rio de la Plata.
Congratulations to Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi Club for winning the Manyavar Bangladesh Premier League 2014-15.
Congratulations to Sheikh Jamal; poster urges resting main players and preparing for the AFC Cup.
Local top scorers for the 2014-15 season led by Enamul Haque with 13 goals.
Fan heard Akmol played for Wales U19 and asks if anyone knows more.
Poster concedes there may have been some irregularities in Sheikh Jamal's league win but defends the club and congratulates them on their 3rd league title.
Fan asks others to check Dinas Powys FC's Wikipedia squad list, where a Bangladeshi striker named Rimon Khan appears.
Fan praises Rizwan's devastating play in a video and wants to see him in a Bangladesh jersey soon.
Video of Akmol Ali in action for Wales U19 national team as a right wing-back.
Fan wishes 2-3 more foreign players would come (to the league/club).
Fan hopes Rizwan and Akmol impress national team coaching staff and secure places, strengthening the defence.
Long post on Alex Ferguson's mind games with rival coaches and referees, including 'Fergie Time'.
Bangladeshi U14 goalkeeper Amir Hamza selected for Norwich City's youth team after a 6-week trial.
Top 12 local scorers in the BPL 2014-15 excluding penalty goals, led by Enamul (Muktijodha) with 8; links to goalbangladesh.com.

Bare link to a Daily Janakantha article (no headline or text given).
Fan post: happiness is playing football in the rain, sadness is a match abandoned for rain.
Did you know? Emeka Darlington played for Saudi Arabia, Tunisia, South Africa and Nigeria leagues before joining Sk. Jamal DC.
The president of Sheikh Jamal Club, Mr. Manjur Kader, announced 20 lakh taka for the Premier League winning team.

posts.summary: Admission starts today: a Dainik Janakantha report dated 31 July 2015 says the Bangladesh Football Supporters Forum has established the privately run BFSF Football Academy in Motijheel, Dhaka, with admission forms for 100 taka, admission fee 1,000 taka and monthly fee 300 taka; contact general secretary Shahadat Hossain Zubayer or joint general secretary Suman.

Some people present the media in a different way, but is the media responsible for this state of football? Football itself created this state: the country's big league is held on one ground, cricket never harmed football to this state, it came on its own merit, and cricket was never football's rival; the BCB spread cricket across the whole country, so now it gets results, while BFF does not come outside Dhaka, so no results come, and without good results it will not come in the media; when football does well, you and I must tell the media, then the media will come on its own.
The SAFF U16 grouping has been finalised: Group A has hosts Bangladesh, India and Sri Lanka; Group B has Maldives, Nepal and Afghanistan.

A few days ago the poster talked about a boy named Pipas, from Feni, who plays in an Italian club; today he talked to his father, who said if the situation in the country improves, he will send him to Bangladesh; the poster tried to bring him to the country.
Where can I get the latest points table of the Special Olympics Games? Any streaming link for today's final match against Great Britain?
Why so much torture on BNS?

Profile of Sheikh Russel's recent recruit Damir Ibric: 12 years of playing career and 12 clubs changed, from Gençlerbirliği and Yıldırım Bosna in Turkey to Qingdao Jonoon in China, Eyüpspor, Araklıspor and Kocaelispor in Turkey, Concordia Chiajna in Romania, T-Team in Malaysia and Mladost Velika Obarska in Bosnia, now Sheikh Russel KC with two matches and two goals; Zlatan be like, that is my boy.

As host of the SAFF U16 tournament, BFF is getting 50,000 dollars; after that BFF will organise two more AFC tournaments with good money, so in the future BFF should bid for a FIFA tournament, and infrastructure development will happen with the allocated money.
Johnson has joined Sheikh Jamal.
Independence Cup will be played on October 18th.

If you want to create an aura for football in this country, then steps like BSSL and playing friendlies with big footballing nations are the right steps; and yes, we need to play that friendly with Portugal; do not worry about the money, sponsors will provide it because there are people looking to whiten their black money; forgive the poster if he is rude.

Long post on Portugal possibly coming to Bangladesh: some say Ronaldo may also come if you can give 25 crore taka, but the poster argues that at this moment, Portugal or Ronaldo magic cannot develop football, and spending that money on the country's football might develop something; sponsors would see it as a hot cake because CR7 is in the match, and for big companies like GP and Robi, 25 crore is nothing, but if BFF asked them for 25 crore for academy development, they would ask what football is, since an academy gives no business interest, while a Ronaldo match gives promotion; the poster asks readers to imagine themselves as such a company's CEO and decide.

If the league ends on the 20th, how many days of preparation will there be for the World Cup qualifiers? At least three or four days will go in travelling; could the league not be stopped for now and finished after the World Cup qualifiers? The poster fears the players, playing continuously, will become tired again.

The group has been very active for the last few days with football discussions, criticisms, debates and arguments, some logical and some illogical; the poster reads almost every post and comment, and Arefin bhai is back like before; it feels good, really good.
Farashganj would have been out of the league anyway and relegated anyway; now they gave a walkover showing a bit of drama; let us see what the league committee's by-laws say about this.
What is the score in the Sheikh Jamal match?

Off topic but football-related: the poster enrolled his younger brother and cousin in a football academy, but his uncle objected, saying football has no value now and to enrol them in cricket; teenagers are already being burdened with career thoughts, and the whole of Bangladesh is like this, so how will footballers emerge?

Off topic: a Bangladeshi youth inspired by Ronaldinho, Syed Muktasid, is now the world's talked-about football freestyler, known as Super Syed; an Arsenal supporter currently in South Africa, he finished in the top six in the African Football Freestyle Championship and, with his friend Kamalio, created a website called Freestyle Mind.
Facebook story link: see this post's comments.
If there is any age-level trial, please let me know.
Will Mohammedan ever win the league title again?

For giving a walkover in a match, Farashganj has been suspended from the Bangladesh Premier League for two years, along with a fine of 5 lakh taka, and the BFF disciplinary committee has ordered the return of 13 lakh taka from BFF.

Long history of Dhaka Mohammedan, the classic black and whites: started as Kolkata Mohammedan in 1891 to keep Muslims organised, with Khan Saheb Syed Ahmed Rased playing a key role; around 1933 a branch was created in Dhaka, which in time surpassed the main Kolkata club; FIFA ranked it 33rd among Asia's top 100 clubs last century, best in South Asia; it was the most successful club in the Aga Khan Gold Cup, champions in 1959, 1960, 1964 and 1968, and reached the semi-final stage of the 1988-89 Asian Club Championship, beating Persepolis and April 25; it won the Dhaka League 19 times, the Federation Cup 10 times and the Super Cup twice, and produced players from Kaisar Hamid and Sabbir to Emily, Hemanta, Jewel and Zahid; the poster, a die-hard Abahani fan, says he is proud to have such a royal rival.
Is there any MBPL match today?

Today at Abahani Krira Chakra, on Sheikh Kamal's birthday, awards will be given for contributions to various sports; in football this year, national team captain Mamunul Islam Mamun is going to receive the Sheikh Kamal Gold Medal, and the Prime Minister herself will hand over the award; congratulations champion.
Mohammedan Club's owner is Bajitpur's son, industrialist Alhaj Zahurul Islam, with a link.
Sheikh Jamal brought a Haitian called Lionel at the start of the season; is he still there? Watching the video, he seemed like a great finisher.
Latest update of BSSL, with a Facebook photo link.

Only six days left until the AFC Cup play-off: Benfica de Macau vs Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi on 13 August 2015; the poster feels nervous, wants Sheikh Jamal to win both matches and confirm the next round, and recalls that Bangladesh beat Macau 3-0 in the AFC Challenge Cup qualifiers, with Mamun scoring from Zahid's assist and ZH7 scoring two world-class goals from almost midfield.
Will anyone show the U16?

Let them keep hating us; we ourselves do good things for Bangladesh's sports: the Sheikh Kamal Sports Complex will have a gallery of about five thousand seats with player accommodation behind it, long-term camps for U19 football, cricket and hockey players, an academy section, and will take two to two and a half years and cost 450 crore taka on about 30 bighas, with modern football and cricket grounds, a club building, basketball court and indoor, a 4,000-seat convention centre, health club, swimming pools, gym and training centre.
Will any channel show the U16 SAFF Championship? What is the news of Rizwan and Akmol?
For us ordinary people who love local football, there is only one thing to say: happy footballing.
The picture will not be deleted, right? With a Wikipedia link to Jewel Rana's Brothers Union section.
Is the number 30 jersey with the shaved head Johnson? Jamal Bhuiyan and Mamun are resting today, Toklis is in the XI; after five minutes, Muktijodha 0-0 Jamal.

35 minutes: Mukti 1-0 Jamal; Enamul gave neither an assist nor a goal, Camara scored, but what Enamul did with the ball was extraordinary, taking it forward and making a back-heel pass to a Mukti player and a small pass to Camara for the goal.
1-1; poor goal keeping! Titu.

Rumours: CMG is willing to support BFF for the Bangladesh vs Portugal match, and in return for this financial support they are willing to host BSSL, not the UK Soccer League; should BFF go for it? The UK Soccer League is coming to Bangladesh this Saturday to officially sign their contract deal.
Full time: Sheikh Jamal 2-1 Muktijodha, with Emeka and Landing scoring and Camara for Muktijodha.
Can Kamalapur Stadium be made like that, since it is made only for football? At Bangabandhu Stadium, not only football, everything happens.
Where can I get the Bangladesh jersey? Please let me know.
Temperature will not be a problem for Jamal, with a BBC weather link.

About three years ago, when the BFF boss came as president for a second term, he promised a high-profile Dutch coach and BFF brought De Kruif, who said in his first press conference he would bring Bangladesh into the top 100; after passing the first test of 2013 well, the 2013 SAFF was bad again due to various syndicates, then the coach-BFF salary drama, a good result at the 2014 Asian Games, the coach sacked and then brought back, and now the coach is with the team in picnic mood; in 2012 Bangladesh were ranked 155-160, and now 170, so how long until 190?

Four weeks left: when will our coach come? He will come soon; what is our assistant coach doing? Busy with the U19 team for the AFC U19 Championship; where are our players? Busy playing on a muddy field and BFF kept them busy with league matches; and what is BFF doing? That is none of our business; good luck Bengal tigers.

Four weeks left and the coach is yet to come to Bangladesh, reportedly not interested to start camp without Sheikh Jamal's players; Kruif is like: my dear Jamal coach Afusi, build the team for me, I will attend the match with your formation; meanwhile Jahid, Hemonto, Emily, Enamul, Jewel, Mishu, Reza, Wali, Sahed and Komol are on vacation in their villages eating beef, korma, kabab and roshogolla, and will perform a belly dance in the Perth football ground with tiny bellies.
Just as in cricket we use the hashtag #riseoftigers, in football we can use the code #RoarWithBengalTigers; what is everyone's opinion?
What is Johnson's position?

Many foreign coaches came and coached Bangladeshi clubs: Joseph Afusi, Omar Sise and many more; for the poster the best foreign coach in the league was Rui Capela, former coach of Dhaka Mohammedan, and he would like to see him again in Mohammedan or some other club, or BFF could appoint him for the U19 national team.
Brothers 1-0 Rahmatganj; to get it live, download this app for football news of Bangladesh and all countries, Java only.
Feni 1-0 Sheikh Russel, 10 minutes.
Feni 1-1 Sheikh Russel, 25 minutes to play.
Emeka and Landing will play in the starting XI; Johnson has not joined the team.
Sheikh Russel, from birth, collects good players and makes a team; they do not have money problems like Mohammedan, Abahani and other teams, yet why does the team not get good results?
Feni 1-3 Sheikh Russel at 56 minutes.
It is time for our Bengal Yellow.
Feni 3-3 Sk Russel at 66 minutes; what a match!
Gooooooallllllll: Sk Russel score; Feni 3-4 Sheikh Russel at 90+2 minutes.
Any news regarding Raheem Fernandez, a Bangladeshi-origin player who plays in Kehler FV?
Today's football matches: Brothers Union 1-0 Rahmatganj, Feni 3-4 Sheikh Russel; next match on 10 August 2015: Brothers Union vs Feni at 4:15 pm.

Supporters of Bangladesh Football, Sylhet zone member registration is ongoing: send the three-month membership fee of 300 plus 10 taka via bKash to 01622-495039 and email name, mobile number, email address and date of birth to sbfsylhet@gmail.com; registered members will get to watch the U16 SAFF Championship from the ground and an official SBF T-shirt; come to the ground, watch the game, keep football alive.
When will the national team camp begin? The poster suggests favourite assistant coach Titu call Akmal and Rizwan for trial.
Looking to play football around Khilkhet; if any match is available, please message me.

Yes, Akmol's fitness level is not good, but does that mean Rizwan's fitness level also could not satisfy the coach? They were far ahead in body fitness; what happened inside, a good coach can say, because the coach saw them up close; on the 3rd Bangladesh face Australia in Australia, with a match in Malaysia before that, and hopefully something good is ahead.

We want Akmol and Rizwan in our national team; mind it, it is the Bangladesh national football team, and the head of the syndicate panel, Titu saheb, it is not your own business, so be scared; time to roar.

East Bengal and Mohun Bagan will play in the Sheikh Kamal International Gold Cup in Chittagong in October, probably 18-28 October, with eight clubs, four hosts and four foreign clubs; the last big tournament in Chittagong was the 1982 Mayor's Cup, won by Muktijodha Sangsad over East Bengal and Mohun Bagan, and talks with Nepal's police team are almost final, with one more foreign club, from Sri Lanka or Maldives, yet to be finalised.
Good news: Bangladesh U12 1-0 Ansan Junior FC of South Korea; congratulations Bangladesh U12 team.

BSL delegates are departing from London Heathrow at 6:30pm UK time and will land at Shahjalal International Airport on Sunday around 11:30am BD time to meet BFF officially with the full BSL proposal and meet media, supporters groups and prospective media partners; the poster urges all Bangladeshi football lovers to raise their voice in support of BSL, calling it the only genuine opportunity to see Bangladesh play the World Cup.
Happy birthday, Topu Barman; this boy was forcibly made a defender, his dribbling is extraordinary and his speed good, and when the poster sees Marcelo's game he remembers Topu bhai.
The new offside rule being introduced in the 2015-16 English Premier League explained; only in the EPL for now, but the poster thinks it is a progressive change.

Please vote for Abu Nasir to be re-elected onto the Liverpool FC Supporters Committee; he has campaigned and represented fans from every part of the globe and has influence and a good relationship with the club's hierarchy; the poll closes Tuesday at 9.00am UK time.
Good luck to our dear coach Maruful Haque, with an Alokito Bangladesh link.

Good news everywhere, yet somehow good thoughts do not come to mind and the poster cannot be optimistic from the heart; has his own mentality become negative, or is what he sees with open eyes true? He is confused.
Someone please give the AFC Cup match schedule, especially the time; will any channel show it?

Surprise! One of the best coaches of Bangladesh, Shafiqul Islam Manik, joined Chittagong Abahani; the president said they are going to make a big-budget team with a class academy in the port city; a big revolution is coming.

The boy holding the football is the poster's own younger brother; he tore his ligament playing a football match, had an operation the day before yesterday, and is still in hospital; the poster asks everyone to pray for his recovery so he can return to the field quickly.

Almost all elite players are staying in Sheikh Jamal; Chittagong Abahani should lure the bench names from them with good money, add rising youths like Manaf, Jewel, Ibrahim and Mashuk, and proven players like Jahid Parvez, Wali Faisal and Meshu, plus one or two quality foreigners, and build an academy, which would push Sheikh Jamal, Russel, Mohammedan and Abahani to follow; a big team also needs a big, well-maintained stadium like MA Aziz Stadium.

What did Mr. Titu actually mean? He said the players understand tactical matters well but physically and technically their standard is still not like playing in the national team; the poster asks in which way they are not physically good, and if there was a technical deficiency, how does Akmol get a place in the Wales U19 team?
Has the India U16 vs Sri Lanka U16 match started? Can I get an update?
India's wing attack is looking good.
Full time: India U16 5-0 Sri Lanka U16.
Why an ugly post on a beautiful page?
Ponders End won the Summer League today, Alhamdulillah.

Are we witnessing a new beginning and the end of an era? Sk. Jamal started from the bottom and now they are the giants; Chittagong Abahani started from the bottom and now they are on their way to the top; what about Dhaka Abahani and Mohammedan, is it the end of an era for the Dhaka old rivals?

Yesterday brought a lot of good news, especially that Chittagong Abahani will build an academy, which the poster liked, since clubs build players; Sheikh Jamal has not been able to build an academy so far though it lacks nothing, Mohammedan and Abahani also need academies, and Sheikh Russel announced with much fanfare that they would build an academy and their own ground, though how far that has gone is unknown.

entities.name: Jonathan Richard
entities.role: chief commercial officer, Soccer League International

posts.summary: Alokito Bangladesh report: with the goal of investing 500 million pounds in Bangladesh football, a Soccer League International delegation arrived in Dhaka with a five-year proposal, the first two years for infrastructure work and a franchise league from 2017 with eight teams linked to English clubs; it depends on BFF's decision, and CEO Mohammad Abdul Kabir and chief commercial officer Jonathan Richard will meet BFF president Kazi Salahuddin, while general secretary Abu Nayeem Sohag says two institutions came with proposals before and never communicated again, so BFF wants to see whether the proposal is realistic.
Today, when will the Bangladesh U16 match start and on which channel will it be shown?
Everyone quickly turn on Channel 24: a BSL representative will join live in the Beyond the Gallery programme.
A programme on BSSL is going on on Channel 24; if you want, you can watch.

After watching yesterday's match, it can be said in one word that India U16 are the hot favourites in the SAFF U16 tournament; Bangladesh and India are in one group, and it probably will not be difficult for the hosts to reach the semis, with the equation still in Bangladesh's favour; on the 11th, InshaAllah, the semi will be confirmed.
Feni 0-0 Brothers at half time; if you want to know the live score, comment on this post.
YouTube link: BSSL planning.
Nepal U16 5-0 Maldives U16.
Does Sheikh Jamal take age-level trials?

There has been a lot of excitement about a franchise tournament, but the poster believes in reality, not dreams: in a country with no football infrastructure, no calendar, no proper league, no professionalism, no club structure, poor playing standard and bad refereeing, a franchise tournament would be standardless like the league; India is far ahead with its infrastructure, on-time league and televised matches, and even the cricket BPL stopped for two years after two seasons before the BCB fixed it; a franchise tournament should come only after football stands on a proper infrastructure.
Kolkata Football League matches are also played on turf at several grounds, while our league matches are played only at Bangabandhu Stadium, and it would not be wrong to call it a paddy field.
Jamal may join Pune FC next season; Manjur Kader accepted the deal (not officially).
Sk. Jamal at their practice session; picture credits Emeka Darlington.
Sk. Jamal trainer Ariel Coleman with the team at a practice session; would the poster like to see him as a national team trainer once again?
Wikipedia link to Shahed Ahmed: does he still play?
YouTube link: Number One Forward Of Bangladesh.

Humorous post on the many categories of football fans: seasonal supporters who only watch the World Cup, Euro and El Clasico and suddenly appear in groups posting that Real Madrid will lose and Messi uncle will score a hat-trick, and literary supporters whose classic word choice makes you unsure whether you are reading a Bengali novel, like the one who wrote that Ozil kept Madrid's midfield in love like a mother keeps her child.

Big names are needed: in the Premier League, Jamal, Russel, Abahani, Mohammedan and in the Fed Cup, Mukti play good enough football, but spectators do not come; the I-League's standard is like ours, and Nepal's is worse yet they get good crowds, so there is a problem in our football culture; to draw spectators, even if old, some big marquee names are needed as a business strategy, and local players sharing a dressing room with them would gain mental strength.
Will the Bangladesh vs Sri Lanka match be shown on BTV World?
Saad Uddin, you are one product; the poster saw a full Hazard in him; what a dribbling.
Official match thread: Bangladesh U16 vs Sri Lanka U16; the poster requests that instead of one-line posts in the group, people post here.
Sri Lanka's goalkeeper is playing very well, and our whole team is playing very well; let's see what happens.
Oh, what a game they are showing! Each boy is like a ball of fire.
The current went away; watching the match is stopped.
Can the commentary be heard on FM radio? The current went away.
Bro, am I watching Real Madrid's game? Everything looks like Ronaldo, Bale, James, Isco and Ramos, but if there was one Benzema, news would have come.
Am I watching Bangladesh's game or Brazil's game? Saad is the future Jewel Rana, and the one playing in jersey number 9 is the future Emily; after 40 minutes, Bangladesh 1-0 Sri Lanka.
While flipping through the channels, the poster got full entertainment: De Kruif has been banned for two matches and fined 8 lakh for indiscipline.

Breaking news: in the World Cup qualifiers, Lodewijk de Kruif will not be able to be in the dugout in the match against Australia, and he has been fined eight and a half thousand Swiss francs; everything is finished.
Offside again; hur.
Why is the goalbar so high? Why, why?

Whatever anyone says, the poster is more satisfied watching the U16's game than the national team's football; they are playing completely European style, and if nurtured well, playing the World Cup is no big deal for us.
Should we take four or five of the U16 team to Dhaka Mohammedan? They will become stars like Jewel, Johnny and Ibrahim.
We stopped at four.
When will I get the goals on YouTube?
Without bad luck and misses, the margin could have been 8 or 10 or more; congratulations to the little tigers.
And it is 4-0; well done boys; be ready India, the junior tigers are coming.

SAFF U16 championship update, full time: Bangladesh U16 4-0 Sri Lanka U16; Bangladesh fully dominated, attacking the Lankan D-box about every minute, and three goals were cancelled for offside, one of which was not really offside; Bangladesh will face India in the final group match, and though both have ensured the semi-final, the born rivals will try their best to win.

Coming home after office and watching the second half of the Bangladesh U16 team's game, the poster was simply mesmerised; Saad, Nipun and Rakib were extraordinary, the midfield was well controlled, but in the D-box they do what the seniors do; now the time has come to hand them over to a good foreign coaching staff so no one is lost and the pipeline stays strong; 4-0 is not bad, and on the 13th there will be a dress rehearsal before the final.
BPL live score here, with a flashscores link.
Apparently he misbehaved with the referee in the last two matches, that is why this punishment was given to De Kruif.
The wing attacks are great; the right winger plays really well.

The two young Turks of Bangladesh who set the field alight in today's match are Nipu (9) and Saad (32); with proper nurture they can become future stars, and if they get a chance in any team in the next Premier League there will be nothing to be surprised about; today Nipu scored two goals for the team.
Next generation, new hopes, just let it happen.

Each country has one or two Sheikh Jamals, at most three in the Spanish league, while Serie A and the English league once had six or seven each; the structure of Bangladeshi football was made by the British, with many almost equal teams like Mohammedan, Abahani, Brothers, Muktijodha, Fakirerpool, Rahmatganj, Farashganj and Agrani Bank, but that structure broke long ago and a new structure is being made, like the Bundesliga where one fully strong team pulls the rest along, which benefited the German national team; hopefully Bangladesh will benefit too, but it is risky and long-term.
Match highlights anyone? Bangladesh U16 vs Sri Lanka U16.
It seems confusing: in some newspapers the poster saw SLUK got only the Premier League work and did not get the BSSL, and in some he saw they got both; actually which is correct?

The SAFF U19 final is on 29 August and the Bangladesh-Malaysia match is the same day; if Titu goes with the U19 team he cannot go with the national team, and in the Australia match Kruif cannot be in the dugout; so what now? Is there a chance to appeal Kruif's ban, or can the ban be shifted onto the Malaysia match?
Asian continental club level football, Bangladesh and a deep pain, part one, with a Facebook story link.
On match day, i.e. tomorrow, before the match, can tickets be bought? What is the price like?
Afghanistan and Nepal's players look over-aged.
Asian continental club level football, Bangladesh and a deep pain, second and last part, with a Facebook story link.
Manjur Kader declared 20 lakh taka to the Sheikh Jamal team if they qualify for the next round; just go for it.
Salahuddin, one has to say the man has brains! Excellent business with BSSL.

entities.name: Kabir
entities.role: chairman, Super Soccer League UK International

posts.summary: Photo post with Mahi Uddin Selim, president of the Sylhet District Football Association, Kabir bhai, chairman of Super Soccer League UK International, and committee members of the Bangladesh Football Supporters Forum, Sylhet district.
What time is Sheikh Jamal's match, in Bangladesh time? And someone please give the link to watch it in this post.
Sarowar Jaman Nipu's home is in Sararchar of our Bajitpur upazila.
Worst and top results of Bangladeshi clubs in AFC competitions, with a GoalBGD link.

entities.name: Bangladesh Football - Walking Around The Dreams

posts.summary: Share this on your walls: today at 6pm, the pride of Bangladesh, Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi Club, will face Macau's CSSA Benfica in the AFC Cup play-off qualifier, live on eversport; at 5pm Bangladesh face India in the SAFF U16 group match, live on BTV; the poster recommends the group Bangladesh Football - Walking Around The Dreams and the page GoalBangladesh for Bangladesh football news.
Waiting for two good results: one starting at 5pm, Bangladesh beating India, and another at 6pm, Sheikh Jamal's AFC qualifying mission.
Best wishes to Bengal Tigers U16 and Bengal Yellow Sheikh Jamal; we want the win.

Another 45 minutes: those who, like the poster, cannot afford to buy internet on the computer and watch the match should spread out to cyber cafes with 20 taka in their pocket; whatever you have, be ready with it; we have come to play and will fight with our lives; we will make Jamal win today.
Match thread: Bangladesh U16 vs India U16; during the match everyone comment here, so those who cannot watch the match can get all updates here.
Looking at India's goalkeeper, it seems he is at least 18 or 19 years old; Allah knows if he is really overaged.
Goooaaaaalll: Bangladesh U16 1-0 India U16.
Goal: Bangladesh 1, India 0.
Will we see the magic of Saad and Nipu again today?
What is the news of Sheikh Jamal?

Dominance and midfield ball possession favour Bangladesh, but for some reason the balls are lost in the D-box; at half time Bangladesh are ahead 1-0, and InshaAllah they will leave the field with victory.
Because of this Indian's comment, both matches should be won today.
Match thread: Sk Jamal Dhanmondi Club LTD vs Casa Benfica.
Duplicate post: omg, Benfica scored a goal.
Omg, Benfica scored a goal.

Oh, sleep and our electricity system; more than half seems gone; the poster woke up, turned on the TV, saw 1-1, and the current made a great joke; whatever, he cannot watch it, but if they win, that is enough.
Goal: Emeka, 44th minute; Benfica 1-1 Sheikh Jamal.
The little tigers went ahead 2-1.
Bangladesh 2, India 1; so much fun.
Alhamdulillah, we won.
In the end, we won; feeling very happy.
SAFF U16: Bangladesh became group champions by beating India 2-1; it feels so satisfying.
This time, it is Sheikh Jamal's turn.

Bangladesh 2-1 India: when Nipu, with extraordinary skill, entered the Indian box and was about to score, an Indian player fouled him and Bangladesh got a penalty, from which Atik scored and secured the win; Sarowar Jaman Nipu's home is Sararchar, Bajitpur, Kishoreganj.

Congratulations to the young footballers of Bengal: after Sri Lanka, the youngsters took revenge for last time by beating India 2-1, though there were chances to increase the margin; Nipu has talent but makes some wrong decisions and could become a good striker if nurtured, while Saad, Atik, Shawon and Morshed played extraordinarily; Bangladesh became group champions and play the semi-final on the 16th in Sylhet, where the football-crazy crowds prove the people still love football and BFF should spread the game across the country instead of confining it to Dhaka.
You all watch it; the poster does not enjoy watching online.
Goal, it is 2-1: Sk Jamal Dhanmondi Club LTD 2, Casa Benfica 1, 75 minutes.
Goalllll at 72 minutes, maybe Darlington, not sure; Benfica 1-2 Sheikh Jamal.
Did they score a goal? Seems so, but watching with buffering every two seconds is not enjoyable.
Sheikh Jamal scored again: score 3-1 at 77 minutes; Sheikh Jamal 3-1 Benfica.
Goalll again: Sheikh Jamal 3-1 Benfica.
Golllllll: Sheikh Jamal 3-1 Benfica; what a kick, Mamunul!
Mamun bhai scored the second and third goals for Sheikh Jamal.
Goal.
Goal number 4: Rony scored; Sheikh Jamal 4-1 Benfica.
Sheikh Jamal 4-1 Benfica.
Brace by Shakhawat Hossain Rony! What a player; this man never deserved to be benched in the national team or club; thanks Wedson for not getting a visa.
Casa is being crushed, and ahead Alga will be made Alga (separated).
Goal 4 for Bangladesh; Benfica 1.
If only Isi were there, the fifth one would have happened.
Today is our day; Bangladesh Zindabad.
4-1 finished; Alhamdulillah, the day passed with double joy.
Full time: Sheikh Jamal 4-1 Benfica; for Jamal, Mamun scored two, and Rony and Emeka one each.
What is the score of Bangladesh vs India? Who won?
Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi XI: Sohel, Munna, Linkon, Landing, Mamun (captain) (Raju), Toklis (Rony), Jamal, Sohel Rana (Yeasin), Yeamin, Emeka, Didar.

Today is one of the best days of Bangladesh football: first the little ones beat the best team of SAFF U16, India, 2-1 to become group champions, and in the AFC play-off in Kyrgyzstan, Bengal Yellow Sheikh Jamal thrashed Macau's Benfica 4-1; if sponsorship, television and media all come forward together, football will return to its aesthetic form.

Waking up in the morning, the poster could not think the day would go like this; though he had faith in the little tigers, he could not think his favourite club Sheikh Jamal would put four past Casa Benfica; really, today is a memorable day for all of us.

On one side, Bangladesh U16 thrashed India 2-1 on Sylhet soil; on the other, in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, Bengal Yellow Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi Club kept alive the dream of progressing in the AFC qualifiers by thrashing Benfica FC 4-1; ah, what joy in the sky and air.
Today the best moment as a Bangladesh fan was seeing a player of the team crying during the national anthem; SJDC clinched a predictable win, and the poster does not see why people are so excited.
Congratulations U16 Bangladesh national football team.
Everything should have a limit; the poster does not like anything excessive.

Long post on Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi Club: a truly professional team, founded only five years ago, already twice in a row Premier League champions and twice in a row Federation Cup winners, dominant at home and abroad and considered by many the best team in South Asia; chairman Chunnu told Ekattor the club will rebuild like European clubs, with its own practice ground, home venue, website, club channel and academy, so that one day players like Messi and Neymar will come from it.
Does anyone know the actual age of Nipu, Saad Uddin and the number 6 jersey defensive midfielder? If there is a video of today's match, please share it.
The poster watched the match from the stadium and was struck by No. 44's play; if anyone knows the name, tell him; she has the ability to control the whole midfield, maybe the next Jamal Bhuiyan.

Now Chittagong will say they will take the Gold Cup, give players; Jamal will say impossible, they will play the AFC Cup; meanwhile Mohammedan, Mukti and Russel will say, did we come floating? Where will we get so many players? Everyone will build academies.
How can there be so much emotion in people's writing? Reading Al Amin's feature in the Daily Star, the poster's heart feels strange.

People said Bangladeshi strikers are not good enough for international matches; presenting Shakhawat Hossain Rony, who did not get to play 90 minutes all season but still scores at international matches; the poster wants to see him in the Bangladesh squad against Australia.
Does anyone know the result link of the AFC selection round 2016?

India will play the U17 World Cup in 2017; does this World Cup have no qualifying round? The way Bangladesh's youngsters thrashed the Indians today, they too should get a chance to play in the 2017 World Cup; anyway, they are no less than India.
Duplicate post: BabaGol co-writer Yossi says the Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi match on Saturday is one of the three matches chosen for the blog's weekly recap.

Good news: Yossi, co-writer of the international football blog BabaGol, says the Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi match on Saturday is one of the three matches chosen for the blog's weekly recap, and everyone is invited to the blog.

A draw takes Bangladesh to the next round, so let the players stay relaxed and play their natural game; no fear of Alga, though it will be somewhat tough, and the Kyrgyz play in the World Cup qualifiers was monstrous; the win against Macau was expected, and now will be the real fight.

16 August: in the SAFF U16 semi-final in Sylhet, Bangladesh will perhaps face Nepal or Afghanistan at 6pm, and on the same day in Dhaka will be the Dhaka Derby, Mohammedan vs Abahani, at 6:30; both are important matches on the same day, and the poster will watch the little tigers' match.
Question post: a Barca-playing associate of Kruif who will stay in Bangladesh for a few years because of his wife's job was supposed to take charge of the BFF academy; what will happen to them?

entities.name: Nikola Kavazovic

posts.summary: Tribute to Jamal Bhuyan, the wall of Bangladesh: man of the tournament in the King's Cup in Bhutan, the Bangabandhu Gold Cup and the Federation Cup in the last nine months; Nikola Kavazovic dubbed him the best defensive midfielder in South Asia, and De Kruif thinks the same; he has played in Europe with Hellerup IK and FC Copenhagen and in China with Shanghai Shenxin; one day he will be where legend Monem Munna is.
We, InshaAllah, will play in the main round of AFC U16.
MK Dons play in the Capital One; the poster saw on Ten Action that the next match is against Preston North End.

Mr. Manju will understand the real fun this time: Sheikh Jamal has almost reached the final round, and when Sheikh Jamal's name is on everyone's lips in Asia, he will understand what a useless tournament his team has played all this time.
Football in rain is really fun.
In today's only match in Chittagong, Chittagong Abahani beat Brothers Union 1-0 with Rakhine's goal.

That moment when Bangladeshi football fans realize they will have an exciting footballing week: 15 August AFC Cup play-off Sheikh Jamal vs Alga FC, 16 August the Dhaka Derby, 16 August U16 SAFF semi-final Bangladesh vs Afghanistan, 18 August final Bangladesh (probably) vs Nepal or India; let's rock Bangladesh.
Only one day left for the Dhaka derby, on 16 August; any sky-blue fans here? We will prove that the colour of Dhaka is sky blue; only Dhaka Abahani is real.
Off topic: today's match, Nepal national team 0-0 Nepal U19.
Everyone is so busy with SAFF U16 and the AFC Cup, no one realizes that the Dhaka Derby is on Sunday.
Can anyone say whether the U16 team is BFF's academy team or a mix of some academies and selected players? BFF should nurture this team.
Goal Bangladesh link: Lt Sheikh Jamal DC is about to change the trend.
No, Mamun's free kick did not touch Sakhaowat Rony's head; it was a direct free-kick goal; four goals are obligatory to watch; Mamun, take a bow, champ, the poster is proud to be his fan.
Does anyone know how many goals Chittagong Abahani striker Chowmrin Rakhine has scored in total, including today's goal in the league?

The poster did not want to post, but asks whether there is any need to poke the Indians in the group; everyone here is an incredible fan of Bangladesh football, but let us be a bit mature and prove everything with results, so the standard of the group survives.
Tomorrow Sheikh Jamal's possible formation is 4-3-3, with a possible change of Rony in for Toklis.
What a loss the poster made by not being able to watch the Bangladesh vs India match; now he regrets a lot, because he could not watch India being bashed.

The poster misses football before 2007: Alfaz, Nakib, Joy, Arman Mia, Munna, Hasan, Rajani, Aminul and Kanchan were his heroes, and the Nitol Tata tournament mixing 20-30 clubs from across the country with Senior Division clubs was in his eyes better than the current Bangladesh Premier, which has become like the Dhaka League.
Link to a Goal Bangladesh article on the rivalry between Bangladeshi clubs and Indian and Central Asian clubs in AFC competitions.
Does anyone know this player from the link? Maybe he is a Bangladeshi footballer who plays for Sporting Bengal United FC.
Kesto or Raihan, neither played the last match; interesting.
Unofficial match thread: Lt Sheikh Jamal Club Dhanmondi vs FC Alga at 6:00 Bangladesh time, with an online streaming link; the poster's prediction is Jamal 3-1 Alga.

Sheikh Jamal today are playing 5-3-2, with Nasir in Toklis's place; they seem to have come with a draw in mind, but the fans want a win today as well; line-up: Sohel, Nasir, Munna, Linkon, Landing, Mamun (captain), Jamal, Sohel Rana, Didar, Yeasin, Emeka.
On which channel is the match being shown? Please help.
Want Sheikh Jamal's update.
AFC live link shared for FC Alga vs Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi Club; the poster is watching live there.
Is the match going to be shown on television?
Damn, one goal: Sheikh Jamal 0-1 Alga.
Is it the end for Jamal's AFC Cup mission?
Alga took advantage of Sheikh Jamal's defence at Alga's home and went ahead 1-0 in the first half; InshaAllah Sheikh Jamal will turn around in the second half.

Where are the Abahani fan brothers? Why is everyone silent? Do you all remember tomorrow is the Dhaka derby? Sheikh Jamal is the fourth subject and Dhaka Abahani the main subject; tomorrow we will show the black-and-whites that the colour of Dhaka city is sky blue.
Goal celebration: heaven, heaven, SKJ is love.
We went to the second round, hurray.
It feels so good to watch the celebration; thank you Mamun and company; this draw was more than a win; joy Bangla, joy Sheikh Jamal.
Duplicate post: full time Sheikh Jamal 1-1 Alga, Emeka scored for Sheikh Jamal and goalkeeper Sohel was extraordinary; congratulations Sheikh Jamal.
Full time: Sheikh Jamal 1-1 Alga; Emeka scored for Sheikh Jamal, and goalkeeper Sohel's play was extraordinary; congratulations Sheikh Jamal.
Next round Sheikh Jamal should try to get better foreign players; Emeka is good, and the poster suggests Walson Augustine and Sunday for Sheikh Jamal.
Who could we face in the next round? Please let me know, the poster cannot wait.

Did anyone notice? Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi qualified for the next round of the AFC Cup on the same day, 40 years ago, when Sheikh Jamal, Sheikh Russel, Sheikh Kamal and Bangabandhu left the earth; an emotional day for Bangladesh.
Who is the player of the match? The poster thinks Sohel Rana.
Even though the poster could not watch the match due to personal busyness, he is very happy just hearing the news; a draw with the host champions in difficult weather is a very good thing.

Next is the preliminary round, where Sheikh Jamal will face Al-Khalil from Palestine, the 2015 Tajik Cup winners, 2015 Afghanistan league runners-up and 2015 Turkmenistan Cup winners; this round will be played from 27 January to 2 February 2016.
Congratulations Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi Club.
The poster almost forgot that tomorrow is the Dhaka derby and is not interested this time; good luck to the young tigers for tomorrow's match against Afghanistan.
Will Sheikh Jamal manage to go to the main round? After the second round there is a third round too, and surely a very tough opponent will come in the third round; why so much hassle?
In Sha Allah, we are the best.
Which is Asia's Europa League, the AFC Cup or the AFC President's Cup?
Humble request to all friends to like the poster's page; with their inspiration he will try to give good updates.

The Daily Star and Alokito Bangladesh wrote that in the AFC Cup play-off, the clubs of Bangladesh and Pakistan that qualified will play each other to qualify for the main round; the poster did not understand anything.
Please provide a BTV live link if anyone has one; the poster cannot watch the match from the office, so the online link is the last hope.

Perhaps the season's second derby is also its last: today at 6:15 pm at Bangabandhu Stadium, Mohammedan face Abahani; Mohammedan beat Abahani 1-0 in the first meeting with Ibrahim's last-minute goal, and the two teams play today to confirm third place, though the title is already decided.

Analysis of the 2016 AFC Cup: against 16 slots in the East there are 20 teams, but if North Korea withdraws like last year there will be 18, and if Indonesia's banned clubs also do not take part, 16 teams will enter the group stage directly with no play-offs; in 2015 the West had 23 teams for 16 slots with 7 play-off matches, while the East had 17 teams and 1 play-off.
What is the state of the match? Dhaka traffic did not let the poster watch the match; he planned to come home at 2:30, bathe and sit to watch, but it will take another 10-15 minutes to reach home.
Admin, again a bad post here, remove it.
Please give the Bangladesh vs Afghanistan score update here.
Laughter only.
Half-time: Bangladesh U16 0-0 Afghanistan U16.
Football is still alive.
Half time: Rahmatganj 0-1 Russel, with a flashscore link.
Goaaal: Bangladesh 1-0 Afghanistan.
Saad goaaaaaaallllllllll.
Wake up Bangladesh.
Will the yellow and red cards of SAFF be effective in the AFC qualifiers?
64th minute: Rahmatganj 0-3 Sheikh Russel.
For the first time we are the finalists of the SAFF Under-16 Championship; thanks to Allah, congratulations to our junior tigers.
Can anyone give me the video of today's goal?
Congratulations junior tigers: in the first semi-final of the SAFF Under-16 Championship 2015, Bangladesh reached the final for the first time, thrashing Afghanistan 1-0; scorer Saad.

The poster can say for sure the match was between Bangladesh U16 and Afghanistan U20, with kung-fu style play, and the little ones played extraordinarily; hats off, and for the first time Bangladesh are in the SAFF U16 final.
U16 SAFF Championship final: India U16 vs Bangladesh U16.
Heard India's main U16 team went to Germany, where they beat Frankfurt's age-level team; and this is the B team.

Many in this group were confused whether this is India's U16 main team; the main thing is this team went to play SAFF U16 as India U16, so since it represents India at the subcontinental level, at this moment let us consider it the main team.

Newspaper report: Rahmatganj thrashed, Sheikh Russel runners-up of the league, beating Rahmatganj 4-0 with a Paul Emile hat-trick and a Mithun Chowdhury goal; Russel finished with 42 points in 20 matches, while champions Sheikh Jamal have 48 points in 19 matches.

SBF was at the ground as always, encouraging the 11 tigers, and they repaid with double the love: speed, dribbling, tackling, man-to-man marking, clean sheet, everything, never relaxing or playing defensively after scoring, unlike the national team; Faysal's last-minute save was high class, and after Aminul Bangladesh are getting another world-class goalkeeper; Nipu, Saad and Anik are stars who must be nurtured; the final is on the 18th against India.
We will leave the field with joy, InshaAllah.

Long match-day narrative from the stands: the crowd started chanting Faysal Faysal, in Sylheti Foychol, as goalkeeper Faysal saved a bullet-speed shot and a corner punch against Afghanistan; Faysal came from Canary Wharf, where his goalkeeper coach Khaled left a promising playing career to make a Faysal, and in the final the stadium will shake again with Mauka Mauka, Bangladesh Bangladesh and Faysal Faysal.
Sheikh Jamal's T-shirt is just wow! Where can I get it?

The National Disabled (Sports) Council is being dissolved; it was a thorn for all sports, especially football, and full of corruption from birth at every level; many thanks to the finance minister for dissolving it.

Kruif arrived in Dhaka yesterday morning; national team practice starts from the 21st, the team goes to Malaysia on the night of 26 August, plays a friendly against the hosts on 29 August, then goes to Perth for the away match against Australia; within a couple of days the coach will announce 25 names for the two matches.

Sheikh Jamal can make a huge impact at the AFC Cup, but only if they recruit good foreign players: the Wedson-Emeka-Landing trio will be no good at the main stage, so the poster suggests Damir Ibric or Islam Fekry in midfield and Jean Jules Ikanga in defence.
Sheikh Jamal will not win the league next season! Updates coming soon.
In 1999, first SA Games gold, then 2003 SAFF champions, then 2010 SA Games gold again (U23); will our U16 team be able to bring the SAFF champion trophy this time? Best wishes.
Bro, is there anyone who can tell me at what time the final starts tomorrow?
What is the weather in Sylhet? It is raining well in Dhaka; will the match happen properly?
No electricity in our Khoksha since 12pm; someone please share the match update; it feels uneasy not being able to watch the match.
40,000 spectators in the gallery, and 15,000 outside the stadium.
30000+ outside, 20000+ waiting.
Why so few updates in the final match?
Half time: Bangladesh 0-0 India.
It's goooalll; come on Bangladesh, let's football.
Playing well; on this bad ground, better football is not possible; In sha Allah the tournament will end with victory.
What happened to BTV? It is giving Sheikh Mujib's sayings; what happened to the end of the match, does anyone know?
What happened? Why is BTV showing the match?
Due to load shedding in the ground, the stadium's floodlights were off, so the match is stopped.
Did we really win? Not a dream, is it?
Alhamdulillah, champions; Foisal, Nipu and Saad played a great tournament; congratulations to the young tigers.
Yesssssssssssss.
After watching the first shot of both teams, the poster did not watch in fear.
Champions.
Gave India the stick twice in one tournament.
Champion!
What a great win for our young tigers; go tiger go.
Bangladesh won the SAFF U16 football championship title beating India 4-2 in the tiebreaker; full score Bangladesh 5, India 3; greetings and congratulations Bangladesh.
Finally we are champions, beating India 4-2 in the tiebreaker to become champions for the first time; congratulations.
Where do I keep so much happiness? In front of my eyes, my Bangladesh. Champion.
Vague fan post asking what people want to do to him, noting he is a younger brother and on top of that this news.
SAFF U16 champions Bangladesh, runners-up India, man of the match Shawon, most valuable player Nipu, fair play trophy Nepal; thank you Sylhet.
At the final moment of the match, a sudden power failure stopped play at Sylhet district stadium; after some time the match resumed and Bangladesh won in the penalty shoot-out.

Feels like Eid joy: after 2010, another final win; the little tigers made Bangladesh champions and fulfilled Mr. Salahuddin's wish; Nipu, Saad, Shawon and Faysal are the future, and now it is the U19's turn.

What is the name of the little rascal who scored with a panenka in the penalty? This team is made of different metal and played the whole tournament to become champions; a 16-year-old boy giving a panenka in front of 25 thousand spectators needs a Sundarbans in his chest, where there are tigers and tigers.

entities.name: Bangladesh Football - Walking Around The Dreams

posts.summary: Today the group completed one year.
Bangladesh wins the SAFF under-16 championship beating India 5-3 in Sylhet; Sarowar Jaman Nipu from Bajitpur, Sararchar, was selected Most Valuable Player.
In the main time: the Bangladesh U19 team is now in Nepal, and now it is our U19 team's turn; picture credit GoalNepal.
Congratulations Bangladesh national U16 team.
Yet these talents will be lost within a few days.
Congratulations Bangladesh U16.

The poster has not seen the Allianz Arena, Maracana, Bernabeu, Camp Nou, Old Trafford, Stamford Bridge or Signal Iduna Park, but has no sorrow because he watched a match at Sylhet district stadium, where the U16 match had no place to stand while Dhaka's national team matches have empty galleries; the real love of this country's people is football, and one day tigers like Nipu, Saad and Faysal may lift the World Cup on Sylhet soil.

entities.name: Bangladesh Football - Walking Around The Dreams

posts.summary: Admin panel thanks post: the group started when five people added about 200 members and is now a family of 6700+ members, and on the group's birthday the Bangladesh U16 team gifted them the SAFF title; long live Bangladesh football.

Never seen such a football wave in Bangladesh; the poster has started thinking he will see Bangladesh in the 2022 World Cup, and soon no Argentina, Brazil, Spain or Portugal flag will fly in Bengal's sky, only the red-green flag of Bengal.
Can someone please give a post with full details about Bangladesh U16 goalkeeper Foysal?
The country whose players cry hearing the national anthem and celebrate with the national flag, that country's football will go far, In sha Allah.
Happiness is: the headline news on every channel is that Bangladesh are champions in SAFF U16.

Where is Beanibazar of Sylhet now? They have die-hard fans and infrastructure; if the awakening is used, the country will get another powerhouse; give them grants with conditions so they build an academy, produce good players and return to the Premier League.
Bare Facebook video link.

What a league it was across the country, with no publicity at all, yet the young brothers set the whole country alight as if winning the world; the poster argues that if the authorities supervised football schools at upazila, district and division level, BFF would not have to keep lamenting no money, no field, no Messi and no Ronaldo, and the little tigers showed BFF officials who they are.
From this picture, find national team captain Mamunul and Sheikh Russel captain Mithun; can anyone?
Sylhet Stadium, where the match was held, should be renovated immediately, otherwise something unpleasant could happen very soon.
Captain Mamunul Islam is on Somoy TV; hurry, do not miss it.
Congratulations India.
Faysol! Rising Star 2012.
Fan asks whether one can apply for a coaching certificate without playing experience.
Bashundara group gives a 25 lakh taka bonus to Sheikh Russel KC.

Today Mamunul bhai repeatedly said on Somoy TV that every district should have a football stadium; despite Chittagong having a cricket stadium, the football stadium is also used for cricket, so football players get no proper opportunity, and Sylhet Stadium is the same; hopefully the sports minister's attention will be drawn by the programme.
Australian squad for the Tajikistan and Bangladesh matches, with a Socceroos link.
Yesterday at the ground, Sylhet SBF's placard; like Sylhet, the poster wants to say: we want the Premier League in Sylhet.

Indonesia is banned, so one team in their group is reduced; AFC has a rule that points earned against the last team of each group are deducted when a group has one team fewer, so the poster wonders what trouble awaits after this round, whether in the Asia Cup qualifiers or the play-offs.
After winning the final match, the activity of the group has increased; good sign for us.

Prothom Alo article: Nipu and Saad dream of football; SAFF U16 MVP Nipu from Bajitpur was inspired by a local match and trained at a local academy before the Sailor U15, while Saad from South Surma, whose father was a footballer, trained at a Manchester United academy and now studies at BFF's Sylhet academy; U16 coach Syed Golam Jilani has huge hopes for Nipu, and both are Messi fans.
Off-topic: why did India's captain Sunil Chhetri not play the ISL last year?
Preferred team against Australia: forwards to be decided, wingers Zahid and Jewel, midfielders Mamunul, Jamal and Hemanto, defenders Nasir, Topu and Raihan; are we getting Reza and Meshu this time?

Fan poem: everyone sees football in Neymar, Ronaldo, Marcelo and Xavi, but the poster only sees the little tiger cubs, Shawon, Saad, Fahim Morshed, Nipu and Faysal, and believes the Bangladesh U16 team will one day rule the football empire.
U19 SAFF 2015: champions Nepal, runners-up Bangladesh, top scorer Bimal Magar.
Good job buddy, with a Prothom Alo link.
The Sheikh Jamal Gold Cup is apparently in October and Sheikh Russel apparently will not play; why? Does anyone know?

The poster saw in the Daily Star, Alokito Bangladesh and Pakistan's biggest football media that Sheikh Jamal will play a play-off against Pakistan's KESC; he speculates on the format and says putting the two teams in the East would end the trouble.

Kruif says he will accept FIFA's ban and talk to BFF about the fine, which BFF wants to adjust from his salary; the poster jokes that his fate matches Kruif's, conceding late goals in six matches to turn wins into draws or draws into losses, and that his relationship with the referee mirrors the poster's with the exam hall visitor.

Why will this man not be in the starting XI? Enamul Haque's great goals and moments have been lost in the air of Bangabandhu Stadium because the media is not keen to telecast football matches; he is the Federation Cup top scorer with 5 goals in 4 matches, the top Bangladeshi scorer in the BPL with 13 goals, 18 goals this season and 7 international goals in 14 matches.
Excellent goal by Bimal Magar, brace complete; too much class for U19 level; Nepal 2-1 Bhutan.

Kolkata giants East Bengal and Mohun Bagan are coming to Dhaka for the eight-team Sheikh Jamal International Tournament on 17-30 October, with Dhaka's three clubs plus one team each from Maldives, Nepal and Sri Lanka; Mohun Bagan have confirmed, and East Bengal have agreed with some conditions.

A Pakistani TV channel said a KESC official claimed Sheikh Jamal will play a two-legged play-off against them on 2 and 9 February, with the home match in Karachi and the winner qualifying for the AFC Cup main round; the poster is confused by the format and worries Sheikh Jamal might withdraw like in 2012, and argues Pakistan's home matches should move to a neutral venue given the Lahore bombing and the attack on Wasim Akram.
Has Pakistan withdrawn from the AFC U16 Championship qualifiers?
Friendly match, 20 September 2015: Lt. Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi Club Ltd. v Atletico de Kolkata.
First Under-19 SAFF championship, Lalitpur, Nepal: opening match Nepal 3-1 Bhutan, hat-trick for Bimal.
Hey Australia: beating them is very very very difficult, but not impossible; they have 11, we have 11; this morning the poster feels very optimistic for some reason.
Mamunul's free kick, someone heads it in, silent stadium, Bangladesh 1-0 Australia: is it very illogical?

Unserious post: which team will be yours in the Bangladesh Super Soccer League? The poster's team is Rajshahi, city of kings, with suggested names like Rajahs of Rajshahi and Rajshahi Rangers, and he has booked Ronaldinho, Kaka, Tevez, Pirlo and Buffon for the 2018 season.
We want more friendly matches.
The picture turned out awesome.

Last day of member registration for Supporters of Bangladesh Football, Sylhet region: three-month membership costs 300 taka total including registration, ID card and T-shirt; unpaid fees by Friday 7pm mean membership is cancelled, and fees can be paid via bKash.
WTF? Sheikh Jamal is not getting Wedson against ATK.
Fan asks whether the squad has been announced for Bangladesh's World Cup qualifier and Malaysia match, and whether anyone has it.

Alas, Bangladesh no longer has football excitement like before: only 20-30 people come if matches are in Dhaka, but 30-40 thousand by hand count outside Dhaka; people go to cricket grounds to enjoy the game and to football grounds to pass time; grow up BFF, grow up.
