The advantages and disadvantages of the double pivot: the centre is the most key area of the football pitch, and through occupying midfield, you can control the match very easily; midfield can be occupied in many ways, by fielding more midfielders in number or by the quality of your team's midfielders; at various times, various coaches have used various tactics to take midfield and counter-tactics to stop it, and today the poster will discuss such a tactic that is much discussed or criticised; nowadays the double pivot is very popular, so what is the double pivot; in simple language, playing two defensive midfielders is the double pivot, and their work is to protect the defence in a deep block, reduce space in midfield and stop the opposition's counter-attack, and another primary work is to hold possession; what are the pivot's standard duties; the first work is to be active in the empty space between the attacking midfielder and the defence, and another work is to start the attack through intelligent ball distribution, play the role of a key player in ball circulation, reduce space between defence lines through discipline and positioning and stop the opposition's dangerous counter-attacks; what are the advantages of playing a double pivot; very often, the team playing a double pivot is labelled as playing boring football, for example Chelsea: although they won the Premier League in the 2014-15 season, many complained Chelsea plays boring football, and one of the main reasons for Chelsea winning the league was this double pivot, as Fabregas and Matic played this double pivot role; Matic provided defensive stability to the team, while Fabregas, going a bit forward, supported the attacking midfielders, and Chelsea's 4-2-3-1 position then transformed a lot into the 4-1-4-1 formation; this is the biggest advantage of playing a double pivot: it can go a bit forward and support the attack while keeping defensive duty in mind; the double pivot can play different roles according to the coach's wish, and two players can play two kinds of roles; when talking about different roles, the poster must say the double pivot's biggest strength is that one defensive midfielder can press without leaving a big space, because another midfielder will hold his position or mark the opposition's number ten or false nine or be in an advantageous position from which it is easy to react in case early pressing is bypassed; another important role is that it helps maintain the team's structure, and how is that; when a single pivot is played, many times defenders have to go up to press, leaving space, and when a single pivot presses, if he mis-passes or pressing is bypassed early, the defender has to go up a bit to stop the attack, leaving a big space in defence; helping defenders maintain their position is a big work of Matic at Chelsea, pressing from anywhere in his own half so defenders can maintain the defence line; another advantage is that defensive midfielders who don't offer much defensive work can have their position secured by playing a double pivot; as an example, Toni Kroos can be mentioned, as with the ball at his feet, Kroos's distribution or passing is extraordinary, but in defensive work, tackling and interceptions, he is not that good; if two attacking mids play in front of Kroos, a huge gap will be created between the defence and attack lines, and the team will be exposed in front of counter-attacks; by playing a double pivot, another defensive-minded player can cover Kroos's defensive work, and Kroos can dictate the match from a deep position without any pressure of losing the ball, since another midfielder is in support; what are the negative sides of the double pivot; although the double pivot has many advantages, it has some negative impacts on team and individual performance; Pep Guardiola highlighted as a disadvantage of the double pivot that playing a double pivot reduces the chance of playing a creative player; Guardiola himself played as a single pivot in Barcelona, and Guardiola also admitted that many times, playing a double pivot in Barcelona, he struggled to adapt; for this reason, Guardiola doesn't play a double pivot much, and if he does, it's a rare case; a single pivot is possible if your team has a midfielder who is expert in both defence and attack; in Barça there was Busquets, and in Bayern now Lahm plays this role; if you don't have this type of player, then playing a single pivot, a number 8 has to be kept in his support, which Guardiola did in previous seasons at Bayern Munich, playing Thiago as a single pivot who dictates the game from a deep position, and keeping Javi Martinez in his support for defensive work; another disadvantage is that if the understanding between the pivots is not good, the result can be very terrible defensively; if both press at the same time, not holding position, a big gap will be created between the attack and defence lines, and the opposition team will get a lot of space to press; the most obvious downside is that the double pivot reduces a player from the attacking third of the pitch, and although this is not always negative, it reduces the team's goal-scoring chances; finally, you can rate the double pivot both good and bad, but for defensive stability, the double pivot has no match; 7 of the 8 semi-finalists of the last two World Cups played a double pivot, so it is understood that the double pivot's success rate is very high; but in the poster's opinion, when the team has a Busquets-type player who can do both attack and defence, playing a double pivot is pointless, but when the team has two types of players, like Modric and Kroos, then playing a double pivot is logical; In time, Sheikh Kamal football: Chittagong Abahani had informed two months ago about the plan to organise an international club football tournament in memory of Abahani's founder Sheikh Kamal, but even after going far, there was doubt whether the tournament would happen at all; even after fixing the tournament's schedule for 20-30 October, there was various drama about team selection, and one day, after fixing the name of one team, it was changing the next day, and a maze was going on; by then, it was confirmed that the country's champion team Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi is not there, and on this, the club's president Manjur Kader attacked the organiser Chittagong Abahani in sharp language; Sheikh Jamal was not invited properly, and league runners-up Sheikh Russel did not even get an invitation, but yesterday, the organisers removed all doubts about the tournament; Chittagong Abahani's president, MP MA Latif, football chairman Tarafdar Ruhul Amin, organiser Shahabuddin Shamim, along with them, the club's member secretary and MP Shamsul Haque Chowdhury came to the BFF building and informed that the tournament is happening at the announced time; this is the first international club cup at the initiative of a club in Bangladesh; the tournament committee's chief patron is Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, and after the organisers met her the day before yesterday, the work gained speed; the tournament committee's chairman has been made BFF president Kazi Salahuddin, and convener is Chittagong mayor AJM Nasir Uddin; in the end, the tournament is happening with three local and five foreign teams, although it was said there would be four local and four foreign teams, and the reason for five foreign teams was explained by Shamsul Haque Chowdhury, 'Since Sheikh Jamal is not coming, we have taken one more foreign team'; but why didn't Sheikh Jamal come; his answer, 'We invited them with a letter; if they don't come, what can I do'; but Sheikh Jamal's president said they were not invited properly, and no one talked to him; is the responsibility over by sending a letter; on this, Shamsul Haque Chowdhury's answer raised a roll of laughter at the press conference, 'They will not play; they want more money; oh, is money everything; still, we tried a lot, but in the end, they didn't come; if they don't come, should we carry them on our lap'; the purpose of organising the tournament was explained by Tarafdar Ruhul Amin, 'We want to spread the name of the late Sheikh Kamal, founder of Abahani, in this region; in the future, it will spread all over the world'; bringing Chittagong's spectators to the ground is also one of the goals, and the organisers promised to organise it every year; they are not willing to accept that the tournament may lose its colour due to Sheikh Jamal's absence, and rather, a 'grand', 'beautiful', 'elegant' tournament is hoped for; the teams' participation fee is 5 thousand dollars, and the champion team will get 25 and the runners-up 10 thousand dollars; on 12 October, the draw at a hotel in Dhaka; the tournament venue is Chittagong's MA Aziz Stadium, and at the opening ceremony on 17 October, there will be artists from Mumbai; Sheikh Kamal football tournament: 8 teams: 3 from Bangladesh, 5 from abroad; from Bangladesh: Dhaka Abahani, Dhaka Mohammedan, Chittagong Abahani; from abroad: Kolkata East Bengal, Kolkata Mohammedan, De Spingar Bazan Club (Afghanistan), Karachi Electric Football Club (Pakistan), Solid FC (Sri Lanka); match venue: MA Aziz Stadium, Chittagong.

Youth football: BFF enthusiastic, and beside disappointment there is hope too; in two months, Bangladesh played four international youth tournaments and understood its position; sometimes the joy of achievement, sometimes the pain of broken dreams; on 6 August, in Sylhet, the SAFF U16 football started, and Bangladesh's youth flew the kite of dreams in the sky by becoming champions; the next month, in Dhaka, in the AFC U16 football, they lost 6-1 to the UAE and 5-1 to Saudi Arabia; inspired by the U16 team's SAFF championship, the U19 team's SAFF mission started, and in Kathmandu, they were eliminated in the semi-final of that tournament; returning home, that team, after good preparation, played in the AFC U19 tournament that ended the day before yesterday, but at home, Bhutan could not be beaten, and falling behind, somehow a disappointing draw (1-1); Bangladesh, starting with a 2-0 win against Sri Lanka, lost the last match 4-0 to Uzbekistan, and the goal of going to the final round as one of the best five runners-up teams remained unfulfilled in the end, and hope was also buried; whatever the result, youth football spent two months in an international atmosphere in Bangladesh, and such a time has never come before; including the preparation time, for six months, a work festival of youth football has been going on; ahead, the U16 or U19 teams have no international matches, but without sitting, BFF has taken a foreign coach for youth football, and since the 1978 youth Asia Cup in Dhaka, this is the first time; Gonzalo Moreno, a former student of the Barça Academy, will start working with the U19 team from 15 October, and his plan is to do 70 practice sessions with the youth team in the next two and a half months; these tell that youth football is now more at the centre of BFF's attention; but what do the results of two months indicate; coach, officials, everyone has the same words: we have to go deeper, and we have to work a lot; BFF's development committee chief Badal Roy says, 'A lot of work is left; watching the U19 team's play, it seemed they can play, but the problem is, there is a great lack of consistency; they have less presence of mind to adapt to the situation on the ground; actually, they have to play with more attention'; the U19 team's captain, Dhaka Mohammedan's midfielder Masum Mia Jonny, sees the root of the problem in others moving forward, and they are trying themselves, but it's not happening, and his words, 'We missed a lot against Bhutan, that wasn't right, but Uzbekistan is far ahead, so it's difficult to beat them'; this young man also spoke of many possibilities in youth football, but the U19 team's head coach, while seeing possibilities, is also getting a big warning, and the draw with Bhutan is 'shameful' in his eyes; after losing to Uzbekistan the day before yesterday, coming to the press conference, he said in a surrendering manner, 'Youth football development will not happen in one day; our main problem is that the players make ordinary mistakes, which have to be paid for'; football experts are emphasising creating players from the age of 10-12, but some immediate success is also needed; besides, BFF wants to quickly supply some players to the national team, so alongside the academy, BFF president Kazi Salahuddin is thinking separately about youth football; watching the U19 team's play, he also got a shock, but he is not disappointed, 'If I were disappointed, I wouldn't have taken a foreign coach; in these few days, I understood our boys' mentality is very weak, and we have to go deeper with everything'; youth football development is actually demanding that more.

Two teams in the Mok Cup had raised hopes in the SAFF U16 football, and on the back of that hope, the AFC Cup performance of the U19 team spread disappointment, so BFF realised that grassroots football needs more emphasis; for that purpose, in a meeting of BFF's development committee yesterday, several decisions were taken; after this meeting with BFF's grassroots coaches, committee chairman Badal Roy informed that currently, the Sylhet Academy will be recommended to BFF to send the U16 team along with the U14 and U18 teams; besides, the National Sports Council is giving money to all federations for grassroots training, and in football, the committee will ask for this money for the U14 and U16 teams; the U12 and U13 teams will be sent to the Super Mok Cup in Malaysia on 7-13 December.

What has happened has happened; our football has gone from Asia level to below SAFF level over 35 years, as the previous generation saw the Asian Club Championship semi-final to looking for a place in the AFC Cup, or the story of the 3-2 fight with North Korea in the Asian Cup to not even getting a place in the Challenge Cup; our generation started by seeing struggle, though we saw the SAFF win, the Challenge Cup quarter-final, or a direct AFC Cup slot, but struggle was seen more; the reason is not that we went back, actually we didn't move forward, and others moved forward, quite fast, in a planned way, while we stayed stuck; anyway, not moving forward against the surroundings, when everyone around moves forward, is called going back; football or life both match Formula One, and moving forward is the last word; if BFF, instead of staying with the smell of the past, worked a bit more in a planned way; there are some hopeful things: the U19 league will happen in Bangladesh, the BFF academy has happened, Soccer League UK has come forward with the slogan of taking the league outside Dhaka, but still there is a lack of vision in planning; Vision 2022? The poster is not saying impossible, since its qualifiers will take four more years to start, but it will be difficult, very difficult; the generation that will play in those qualifiers is the one that could not reach the main round of the AFC U16 and AFC U19; we have seen how big our gap is with the age-level teams of Arab countries, and the poster is sure the difference with Japan, Korea, China, Australia or ASEAN is similar or more; let's come to reality, and the reality is, our boys are talented; many may play in the U19 league, but still, through camping, through the academy, sometimes through international age-level tournaments, the performance graph has to be seen; four years means a lot of time, 1460 days; if every day we can seriously do the development flow of two or three U16 teams through foreign management, the development flow of the U19 team, we can take the graph upwards, and we will move forward; needless to say, foreign management and facilities have to be provided according to capacity; at least then this generation of Mannaf, Saad, Nipun, Jonny, Ibrahim, Rohit, whether they play the World Cup or not, will play the Asia Cup directly among Asia's best 12 teams and give a good fight in the World Cup qualifiers; none of us has an objection to Vision 2022, and everyone likes big dreams, but good planning should be done around the 2023 Asia Cup, so that in the 2023 Asia Cup we get a very good team, and they will show another generation the dream of the 2026 World Cup; work should be done with the U12s keeping in mind a four-year plan, so that they can play the AFC U16 and U17 World Cups; the improvement graph should be seen by playing tournaments abroad for four years or friendlies with Asia's age-level teams; the U16 generation that could not play the U16 Asia Cup, let them be strongly prepared by skilled management so that they play the U19 Asia Cup and fight in the U20 World Cup; after the care of the U19s through clubs (if the age-level league really happens), BFF has some responsibilities too: sending them abroad, coaching staff, facilities, the habit of playing as a team throughout the year; planning and implementation, two very small words, but the importance is great; sports is much like studying: if someone moves forward little by little in a planned way, success will come; how many backbenchers you will see, they changed themselves in a wonderfully beautiful way through hard work; football is like that too; dreaming will continue, along with working; the day we play the U16 Asia Cup not with age-cheating players but with age-level players, and regularly play and play well in the U19 Asia Cup, then we will play the Asia Cup with dominance; notice that the countries whose age-level teams are good, their main teams are also good; when we get regular good results in U16, U19, the main Asia Cup, at club level become champions or runners-up in the AFC Cup, regularly play well in the AFC Champions League, improve the league's standard, then luck and miracles won't be needed, we will really play the World Cup; a long road, we have to move forward in small steps; the poster's plan's duration is 4 years with all teams; four years means 48 months or 1460 days or 35040 hours; if we work, a lot of time.

be that as it may, the tournament's organiser Chittagong Abahani is going to make a history, as this is the first international club tournament at the initiative of any club in Bangladesh; Chittagong Abahani was born on 11 October 1982, and the ceremony yesterday, a day after its 33rd birthday, got a different significance; at the ceremony, the tournament's organising committee chief, BFF president Kazi Salahuddin, said, 'Abahani was founded by Sheikh Kamal, bringing a touch of modernity to Bangladesh's football; through this tournament, he will be paid proper respect, but this is not only Chittagong's tournament, it is the whole of Bangladesh's tournament'; many arrangements in Bangladesh's sports arena are lost, but the Sheikh Kamal tournament will not float in that current, promised the tournament committee chief, Chittagong mayor AJM Nasir Uddin, 'This tournament will be held every year and we will work on it sincerely'; tournament committee member secretary, MP Shamsul Haque Chowdhury, was hopeful the arrangement will be grand; to keep the gallery lively, every day, through a lottery, a spectator will be given a motorcycle; besides, the winning team of each match will get one thousand dollars and the man of the match 500 dollars, and the teams will get a participation fee of 5 thousand dollars; the champion team's prize money is 25 thousand dollars, the runners-up's 10 thousand dollars; these were announced at the ceremony by Chittagong Abahani's football chairman Tarafdar Ruhul Amin; youth and sports parliamentary standing committee chairman, MP Zahid Ahsan Russell, spoke; present were Chittagong Abahani's chairman, MP MA Latif, Badal Roy, Kazi Nabil Ahmed, etc.; Know about your country's legend: some information about Dhaka Abahani and East Bengal legend Monem Munna: 1. Monem Munna was given the title 'King Back' by Kolkata's football lovers seeing his footwork, and he is more known by the name King Back Monem Munna; 2. seeing Munna's play, German coach Foster said that if Munna had been born in Germany, he would have played in the World Cup for the German national team; 3. in 1991, Munna joined East Bengal from Abahani, and in both the 1991-1992 and 1992-1993 seasons, East Bengal became league champions, and in that 1992 season, Munna got a South Asian record 20 lakh taka remuneration for East Bengal in the second season; 4. in 1993, Munna returned to his beloved club Abahani as captain, and Abahani, which was struggling in the previous season, he made champions in two consecutive seasons, and Munna became champion in four consecutive seasons, twice with India's most famous club East Bengal, twice with Bangladesh's best club Dhaka Abahani; 5. Munna was captain of the Bangladesh national team, and under his captaincy, the national team became champions in a four-nation tournament in Myanmar, and at only forty years old, this legend left untimely, making thousands of football fans of the two Bengals cry; King Back Monem Munna was honoured by East Bengal with a place in the club's Hall of Fame, and Abahani club also considers Munna one of its best legends; the biggest quality of Munna's captaincy and defence was his determination, extraordinary overlapping and dribbling; recalling Munna's passion for the team, Aslam, Munna's teammate at East Bengal and another Bangladeshi football legend, said, 'It was difficult to beat Munna; as an opponent, you would never want him; as a teammate, he was extraordinary; once, while playing for East Bengal, I was injured on the field and fainted, and when I regained consciousness, I saw Munna beside me, crying'; credit: Arif vai.

anyway, read Jugantor's report: BFF election, secret meeting in Dhanmondi-Gulshan; various activities are going on about the Bangladesh Football Federation's election, and to fix the election strategy, a secret meeting was held in Dhanmondi on Saturday evening, while on the other hand, another meeting was held in Gulshan, and both groups of the meeting participants are staunchly opposed to the current BFF president Kazi Salahuddin; among them, the Gulshan group had a close relationship with Salahuddin, and in the 2012 election, the Gulshan group made Salahuddin win by showing the fear of Juju and making the president candidate Abdur Rahim sit down, but the Gulshan group is unhappy because Sheikh Jamal was excluded from the Sheikh Kamal International Club Cup tournament in Chittagong, and they believe that behind the exclusion of Sheikh Jamal from the tournament is the hand of the BFF president; following this, on Friday, Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi Club president Manzur Kader took the BFF president to task, calling him spineless and incompetent; on the other hand, the Dhanmondi group has had a relationship of mutual dislike with the BFF president since 2008, and in the Dhanmondi meeting, the presence of two vice-presidents of BFF, along with a few members and a policymaker of the ruling coalition, and one or two members of parliament, was confirmed, and according to the meeting sources, the BNP-Jamaat coalition's friendship with the BFF president will not be accepted, especially because in 2008, going outside the Awami League and forming a panel with the then nationalists, they are dissatisfied with Salahuddin; in the last eight years, the accounts of almost a hundred crore taka of BFF were also discussed in the Dhanmondi meeting, and their words are that even though crores of taka of BFF were looted, they could not stop it, and because of this failure, what answer will they give to the councillors, they are worried about this, and thinking is also being done about resigning from BFF in protest of irregularities and corruption; in the Gulshan meeting, there was only one voice: without organising the Super Cup and Independence Cup, the football transfer cannot be participated in at all, and if needed, BFF will be forced to organise the two tournaments, and the Gulshan meeting source said that to express solidarity with Manzur Kader's statement, talks will be held soon with other club officials, and pressure will be created on BFF through the club association, and even if the transfer has to be postponed to April or May next year, the clubs agree, and along with that, it has been decided to investigate whose indication was behind the exclusion of Sheikh Jamal and Sheikh Russel from the Sheikh Kamal Club Cup, and if needed, an extreme decision like expelling Chittagong Abahani from the professional football club association may be taken.

Dhaka Mohammedan's ranking as the best club of South Asia in the last century, discussed serially in terms of Mohammedan's performance, part 1 (1985-1990): after the AFC club championship stopped in 1971, it resumed in 1985 after a long break, and in that edition, Dhaka's other giant Abahani got a chance in the AFC club championship, while Mohammedan got a chance in the next edition, in 1986; Mohammedan's performance in the 1986 club championship: Mohammedan 6-2 MMC (champion from Nepal), Mohammedan 3-1 PAF SC (champion from Pakistan), Mohammedan 2-2 Mohun Bagan (champion from India), Mohammedan 1-5 Al Rasheed (champion from Iraq); Mohammedan's performance: in the Asian Club Championship, Mohammedan played four matches, winning two against the Nepalese and Pakistani champions, drawing one against the Indian champions, and losing one against the Iraqi champion Al Rasheed; 1986 AFC club championship / AFC Champions League: group stage: Mohammedan 0-0 Saunders SC (champion from Sri Lanka), Mohammedan 2-1 Persepolis FC (champion from Iran); semi-final stage: Mohammedan 1-0 April 25 (champion from Korea), Mohammedan 2-2 Al Sadd (champion from Qatar), Mohammedan 1-3 Al Ittifaq (champion from Saudi Arabia), Mohammedan 1-2 Pahang FC (champion from Thailand); records: first, Mohammedan gets South Asia's best result in the Asian Club Championship so far, beating the Korean champions and drawing with Qatar's giant Al Sadd in the semi-final stage, and in this tournament, Indian club Mohun Bagan also went to the semi-final stage, which is an Indian record, but there they lost 6-0 to China's champions, 4-0 to the Iraqi champions, and 1-0 to the Kuwaiti club, while Dhaka Mohammedan beat the Iranian and Korean clubs and drew with the champion Al Sadd, finishing the dream journey in third place in the semi-final stage; second, Mohammedan beat Iranian club Persepolis FC 2-1, which is the only win of any South Asian club against an Iranian club in the AFC tournament; third, Mohammedan drew 2-2 with Qatar's famous club Al Sadd, who later became Asia's champion, and this is the only record of any South Asian club drawing with a champion in the AFC Champions League, which is still unimaginable; 1989-1990 AFC club championship / AFC Champions League: Mohammedan 7-2 Victory SC (champion from Maldives), Mohammedan 3-1 Old Mendicants (champion from Sri Lanka), Mohammedan 0-1 Shahin Ahvaz; records: first, Mohammedan made a plain result, being eliminated from the group stage with two wins and one defeat in three matches, and MSC became group runners-up, but since only the champion team goes to the semi-final stage, Mohammedan was eliminated, yet that was still the best performance among South Asia; second, among all South Asian clubs eliminated from the group, Mohammedan got the most points, 4, with the win-loss record, and with 10 goals in three matches, Mohammedan's goal count was also the highest in South Asia, and the 7-2 win against Victory SC was the biggest win of any South Asian club in the tournament; 1990-1991 AFC club championship / AFC Champions League: quarter-final: Mohammedan 5-0 Club Lagoons (champion from Maldives), Mohammedan 2-0 Salgaocar SC (champion from India); group stage: Mohammedan 1-1 Bangkok FC (champion from Thailand), Mohammedan 0-0 April 25 (champion from Korea), Mohammedan 1-1 Esteghlal SC (champion from Iran); records: first, what bad luck, as in the history of the AFC Champions League, Mohammedan is the only club that was eliminated from the tournament without losing any match, with two wins and three draws in five matches, and Dhaka Mohammedan eliminated the Indian and Maldivian champions from the tournament; second, the only club from South Asia that crossed the qualifiers and played the main stage of the AFC Champions League; third, the Iranian champion Esteghlal SC, who drew 1-1 with Dhaka Mohammedan, got the crown of Asia's best club; fourth, where no South Asian club has a record of drawing with any Asian champion, Mohammedan drew with another champion in the 1990-1991 season after the 1988-1989 season; fifth, in the race to become Asia's best club, Mohammedan was unfortunately eliminated from the tournament without losing any match, just two matches behind, and a team that drew with Mohammedan became champions; 1991 AFC club championship: qualifying round 1: Dhaka Mohammedan 5-0 Wapda FC (champion from Pakistan), Mohammedan 0-0 Wapda SC; qualifying round 2: Mohammedan 3-0 New Radiant (champion from Maldives), Mohammedan 2-0 New Radiant; group stage: Al Rayan (Qatar) 3-1 Mohammedan, Al Shabab (UAE) 2-1 Mohammedan, Port Authority (Thailand) 4-2 Mohammedan; records: first, Mohammedan is the only team from South Asia that, like the previous editions, crossed the qualifiers and played in the main stage of the AFC Champions League / Asian Club Championship; second, the record of the most wins and most goals in South Asia is also Mohammedan's; conclusion: due to lack of space, in this episode, the performances of Dhaka Mohammedan and other South Asian clubs in the first six editions were discussed, and in the next episode, the rest of the journey will be discussed; walking on the road of history's smell, glory and misfortune, this realisation will definitely come to you: where we were supposed to go, we could not go, and where we had friendship with Asia's champions and the history of crushing South Asian clubs, there Bangladesh's clubs now do not even keep track of Asia's football; anyway, the summary of Mohammedan's records in the first seven editions is: first, the record of the most participations, five times, belongs to the black-and-whites, and no South Asian club is even close; second, the record of playing the main stage the most times belongs to Mohammedan; third, South Asia's best performance so far is Mohammedan's in the 1988-1989 season's semi-final stage; fourth, where South Asian clubs have a record of losing by big margins to Arab and Korean clubs, Mohammedan's record against Iranian clubs in three meetings is 1 win, 1 draw and 1 defeat, and a draw with a Qatari club, and against Korea's club April 25 in two meetings, 1 win and 1 draw, which is unimaginable for other South Asian clubs; fifth, in the 1985-1991 editions, the record of remaining unbeaten against the clubs of India, Pakistan, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Maldives, and in the first seven editions at Asia's club level, they crushed most of South Asia's clubs in a literal sense; analysis of the record against Indian club champions: 1986 Mohammedan 2-2 Mohun Bagan, 1990-1991 Mohammedan 2-0 Salgaocar SC; record against Pakistan's champions: 1986 Mohammedan 3-1 PAF SC, 1991 Mohammedan 5-0 Wapda FC, Mohammedan 0-0 Wapda FC; against Maldives' champions: Mohammedan 7-2 Victory SC (1989-1990), 1991 Mohammedan 3-0 New Radiant, Mohammedan 2-0 New Radiant; records against Sri Lanka's clubs: Mohammedan 0-0 Saunders SC, Mohammedan 3-1 Old Mendicants; record against Nepal's clubs: 1986 Mohammedan 6-2 MMC Nepal; record against Iran's champions: 1988-1989 Mohammedan 2-1 Persepolis FC, 1989-1990 Mohammedan 0-1 Shahin FC, 1990-1991 Mohammedan 1-1 Esteghlal (champion of Asia in 1990-1991); in the ranking, Mohammedan is the best club of South Asia in the last century and the only club in the top 80, as the performance in the AFC Champions League editions in the twentieth century says, or the performance in the Aga Khan Gold Cup before the AFC club competition started says; to be continued; footnote: as the only club from South Asia in the all-time club ranking, Mohammedan is in the top 80.

Sheikh Kamal International Club Cup, 20 October 2015: the eight teams of the tournament are Group A: Dhaka Mohammedan, Kolkata Mohammedan, Spin Ghar Bazan (Afghanistan), Solid FC (Sri Lanka); Group B: Dhaka Abahani, Kolkata East Bengal, Karachi Electric, Chittagong Abahani; fixtures: 20 October: Dhaka Abahani-Karachi Electric, Chittagong Abahani-East Bengal; 21 October: Kolkata Mohammedan-Solid FC, Dhaka Mohammedan-Spin Ghar Bazan; 22 October: East Bengal-Karachi Electric, Dhaka Abahani-Chittagong Abahani; 23 October: Dhaka Mohammedan-Solid FC, Kolkata Mohammedan-Spin Ghar Bazan; 24 October: Chittagong Abahani-Karachi Electric, Dhaka Abahani-East Bengal; 25 October: Spin Ghar Bazan-Solid FC, Dhaka Mohammedan-Kolkata Mohammedan; 27 October: first semi-final (A1-B2); 28 October: second semi-final (B1-A2); 30 October: final; group stage first match at 4:30 pm and the next match at 7:30 pm; venue: Chittagong MA Aziz Stadium; the first club tournament in Bangladesh at the initiative of a local club; champion and runner-up teams will get 25 and 10 thousand US dollars; in the 8-team tournament, 5 foreign teams; the tournament's venue is Chittagong's MA Aziz Stadium; 'Abahani was founded by Sheikh Kamal, bringing a touch of modernity to Bangladesh's football; through this tournament, he will be paid proper respect, but this is not Chittagong's tournament, it is the whole of Bangladesh's tournament,' said Kazi Salahuddin, BFF President.

On the first day itself, two Bengals at the MA Aziz Stadium premises dressed up nicely, with a five-star hotel and park, neat and clean, and an invitation to a football joy festival all around, and Chittagong's spectators can get ready to quickly dive into that joy festival, as on the first day of the tournament, a 'delicious' match is in front of them; Karachi Electric's opening match with Dhaka Abahani may not be that attractive, but in the second match, the crowd in the gallery will surely increase, which can be called one of the most attractive matches of the tournament, Chittagong Abahani vs East Bengal, and there is no comparison of Chittagong's team with East Bengal, the holder of 95 years of history and a huge tradition of winning 136 trophies, and on top of that, in Chittagong Abahani's 33-year history, today is the first international debut, and that too is happening under the banner of two Bengals, an ideal match for the Sheikh Kamal tournament to heat up; East Bengal is considered the big attraction of this tournament, although 14-15 of the team's players are playing in the ongoing ISL, and still, when the name is East Bengal, it is getting the light, and coach Biswajit Bhattacharya is not thinking at all about who is in the team and who is not, saying, 'Apart from those 14-15, we played two matches and were unbeaten, and we will play as the East Bengal team'; East Bengal's recent form is also going great, as crushing a strong opponent like Mohun Bagan by 4 goals, they recently brought home the Kolkata League title, and the one who scored two goals in that match, that Korean young striker Do Dong, has come to Chittagong, and he is thought to be this East Bengal's trump card; when East Bengal was practicing yesterday afternoon at the Police Line ground, a group of youths came to see the practice and were quite excited, and seeing the East Bengal team in front of their eyes, one told another, 'You know, they play very well; tomorrow I will go to watch the match', but the youths felt disappointed that Sheikh Jamal is not in the home-ground tournament, and even without Sheikh Jamal, it is strongly present in the Sheikh Kamal tournament, and the East Bengal coach said, 'I was eager to play against Sheikh Jamal; I was a little surprised that they are not there'; oh, if Sheikh Jamal were there, a grand fight would surely have happened this time, and Sheikh Jamal beat East Bengal in the last IFA Shield, and that is also a big inspiration in front of Chittagong Abahani; East Bengal is in front, so what, and Chittagong Abahani's coach Shafiqul Islam Manik said about winning this match at home and dedicating it to the spectators, and he formed the team with 12-13 players of Sheikh Russel, and as the contract with Sheikh Jamal ended in August, he also got Jamal Bhuiyan, and with foreigners joining, Manik hopes his team will be seen in a wonderful form, saying, 'We have experienced players; Emily is there, and with Mithun, Reza, Mishu and Hemanta, I hope we will travel far'; this hope of travelling 'far' is of all teams, and no one is a clear favourite, and no one can be kept in the discard list either, and at least 4-5 teams are favourites, although no team has a very clear idea about the opponent, but before the fight on the ground, no one can be kept out of the calculation, and everyone, even if they don't say it out loud, has shown with body language the promise of returning as champions from Chittagong; there has been no domestic game in Pakistan for several months, yet they are also saying they have come on this tour keeping their eyes on the trophy, and Sri Lanka may seem a little weak to anyone, because domestic football there is not that strong, and the coach-captain of that Sri Lankan team also informed of their strong desire to win; The state of professional clubs: they do not obey the main conditions of the bylaws, as the main mantra of AFC club licensing is 'to make the teams of the professional league more organised, strong and their activities faster'; in the 2006-07 season, Bangladesh's football was wrapped in the 'professional' wrapper, but the clubs' behaviour is old, and in the last seven seasons, the standard of play gradually increased, but there was no change in the club officials' mentality; in the 2014-15 season, the Premier League without playing in Chittagong would have become the 'Dhaka League', yet one of the main conditions of the professional league is that clubs have to play on a home and away basis, and like the practice venue, the match venue is compulsory, and although there is a rule that one ground cannot host more than three clubs, last season Bangabandhu Stadium hosted 10 clubs, yet no team wanted to play at Muktijodha's Gopalganj and Soccer Club's Feni Stadium, except BJMC's proposed Tangail Stadium, and although they did not want to go in the first leg, at Chittagong Abahani's strong demand, the teams went to play there in the second phase; first, because they are Dhaka-based, clubs do not want to spend extra money going to play away matches, and second, big clubs are afraid of losing points, and without saying directly, yesterday an official of Sheikh Jamal Dhanmondi Club, unwilling to reveal his name, indirectly admitted it; although having age-group teams is compulsory, in the last seven seasons, no club has been seen with one, and Sheikh Jamal, Abahani and Mohammedan keep two-three players with the main team for practice every year, but do not form a team, and clubs name teams by holding them during the BFF age-group tournaments, with the condition of playing in a league system; Sheikh Jamal, champions of the Premier League for two consecutive seasons, did not even play in the U-16 tournament in the 2012-13 season and the U-18 tournament in the 2013-14 season, and the professional league committee also did not take punitive action against them, only warned; although appointing a marketing manager is compulsory to create sources of income and increase the scope of recognition, after 6 years, the post was filled last season, and if AFC had not given the 20,000-dollar Kick Off project for Bangladesh, there is doubt whether it would have happened at all; 'The bylaws of the professional league are not violated just like that; at the root of everything is money, football has not become a brand like before, sponsors are not found, and there are financial limitations, and as a result, even if wanted, many things cannot be done,' said Brothers manager Amer Khan; club licensing mainly strengthens teams in three ways: infrastructure, administrative and organisational, and all clubs must have a general secretary, secretary-general, director in charge, coordinator and marketing officer compulsory, and clubs were not very interested in appointing a marketing officer either, and even now, the federation does not get an immediate response by contacting some clubs; because the club licensing conditions were not fulfilled, last season four clubs of India's I-League were stripped of their eligibility to play in the professional league, and AFC's eyes are also on Bangladesh, and clubs have also made it clear by subsidising for the marketing officer; although it is said to pay footballers' remuneration monthly by salary system, it is reportedly not compulsory in the bylaws.

The attack Abahani launched in the first half felt very good to see, but again, due to the mistakes of those 'amateur' strikers, nothing worked.
Is it the end for Dhaka Abahani?

Seeing Abahani's one-sided attack in the match felt good, but due to the failure of the 'amateur' brand strikers, the match was drawn and Abahani bid farewell to the tournament; of course, calling these strikers amateurs means insulting the word amateur itself.

Even after starting with a win, giant Dhaka Abahani bid farewell to the tournament; how can it be, man, missing so many chances, and where Chittagong Abahani is in the semi with rented soldiers, there elder brother Abahani bid farewell with a strong team; Abahani continued their failure in international tournaments; congratulations to Chittagong Abahani and East Bengal.

First, let me say the poster wanted Abahani in the semi with all his heart, as Bangladesh's 3 teams would play the semi and the final would be all-Bangladesh, but his wish is not to be fulfilled; now Abahani is an old story: Abahani is a tiger with the country's teams and a cat with foreign teams; his own opinion is that as soon as the league starts, Abahani brings a foreign coach with good local collections and makes a fighting team, but when something outside happens, their style is some rented players and Amalesh-Rupuda as coaches, and he said Rupuda's name because Amalesh da has no coaching certificate, so Rupuda is shown as the coach; Amalesh da was a successful coach in that era, when there was no team called Sheikh Jamal, and fixed matches had entered cell by cell, but education is a big thing to advance oneself, and Rupuda has no Level A certificate, and apart from foreign coaches, whoever is there, all the big teams now have Level A coaches; a request to Abahani: if you play, play properly, otherwise stop the mischief with the country's money, as even Bhutan's academy laughs seeing you.

Till today, the poster has not heard India or any of their teams called a national or A team; does their team level start from B, and when will our players play by understanding the opponents' players' ability without looking at the opposing team's name, only Allah knows best; Arefin bhai said it well: if East Bengal picked up someone from the street and played them with their jersey, even then our teams would consider a draw or a narrow defeat honourable.
Our Chittagong Abahani has gone to the semi-final; come on Chittagong, let's football.
Dhaka Abahani 0-0 Kingfisher East Bengal.

There is nothing for Dhaka Mohammedan fans to jump about; we have not gone to the semi yet, and to go to the semi, we have to get at least 1 point against Kolkata Mohammedan tomorrow, so first let's win, then celebrate with everything, and maintain our own class.
Guys, give another look at the pinned post and behave accordingly.

That question: 'Solid SC beat Kolkata Mohammedan in the first match, against them Mohammedan should have played carefully on this day'; Kaler Kantho Sports: Solid SC beat Kolkata Mohammedan in the first match, against them Mohammedan should have played carefully on this day, but instead they blew the team away completely; Imtiaz Ahmed Nakib: the matter of playing carefully was there, but we had to get a win, that is what was going around in everyone's head, and because of that, the team was attacking on its own, and we lost the first match due to our own fault, and if you waste so many goal chances, can you win a match?
New episode: 1 crore taka is just a tiny amount for us, said Manjur Kader, with a YouTube link.
Dhaka Mohammedan vs Kolkata Mohammedan, time 7:30 pm; a win for us will take us to the semi-finals; good luck lads, Dhaka will be black and white soon.

posts.summary: The chief guest, Alhaj Farid Mahmud, Joint Convener of Chittagong Metropolitan Jubo League, formally inaugurated the football practice of Chittagong City United Club, and the guest is being greeted with flowers; club president: Suman Hossain, cultural and supporters group secretary Irfan and other members.

The poster hopes the sky blue supporters have not broken down; they lost, a matter of great sorrow, but defeat will come at some time, and the team's good time will not last a lifetime, and bad time will come, and the supporter who does not stay with the team in the team's bad time, or hides in fear of the opposing team, should not get the honour of being a supporter of a team like Abahani, and they should go and sit in another team; Abahani is a name that teaches us to stay strong in bad times, and we are strong, and no matter how bad the team's time is, we will stay with the team, and the team lost today, it will lose tomorrow, it will lose the day after, but then the team will win, and the team will win and give everyone a mouth-breaking reply; remember the golden times, we were #UNSTOPPABLE, and we will return to that time again one day, and today, tomorrow, the day after, even in the team's bad time, we will stay with the team, because we are #Abahaniyan, we are sky blue, and we have not learned to break down, we have learned to fight, we will fight, until we become victorious.

Rashed bhai did not do this just like that; many days ago, in one of his statuses, the poster saw among the best 10 footballers he has seen, the first 9 were world-famous footballers, and in the 10th place, he had kept Zahid, and he had written like this: 'If he got a little care and did not act whimsically in his personal life, today Zahid could have been at another level'; Dido did not love the madman just for nothing, and Zahid's hat-trick did not happen according to the rules, but if the referee gave the goal by mistake, then the hat-trick has happened, and this will be only the 3rd Bangladeshi's hat-trick at senior international level; otherwise, excluding his first goal in yesterday's match, his goal count stands at 11 at senior international level including the U23 team, and apart from these 11 goals, in the main round of the 2004 AFC U16 Championship, Bangladesh drew with Uzbekistan with his goal; how many goals did Sabbir have?

Zahid is a very favourite player of the poster, but whenever he becomes hopeful, Zahid disappoints us; if given fitness training, he will not do it, and he will not pay attention to defence, and at the very end, injury; there is still time, and if Zahid lights up, we will play the Asia Cup, and how many more days can he give, three years or four years; will someone explain to him the importance of retiring after playing in the Asia Cup, as only by fixing his own fitness, becoming a 90-minute player and listening to the coach, we can get that.

The fight of the 2 Mohammedans of 2 Bengals, and whichever team wins, that team will go to the semi, and bigger than that is honour; after 2 matches, Dhaka Mohammedan has 3 points and Kolkata Mohammedan has 1 point, and a draw will be enough for Dhaka's black-and-whites; the poster hopes everyone's support today will be on Dhaka Mohammedan, and today also Jewel Rana will not be in the team, black and white.
Group A point table.
The statistics on Jahid Hasan Ameli's Wikipedia page really look scary to the poster too; he doesn't know how correct it is.
Channel 9's commentators give more commentary on the beauty of the female spectators present in the gallery than on the match commentary.

After conceding 6 goals to Dhaka Mohammedan, Solid FC gave Bozan 1 goal in the half time of the next match; if they win this match, Solid will play in the semi, and if they draw or lose, Bozan will play in the semi; in the next match, if Dhaka Mohammedan draw, they will go to the semi, and if Kolkata Mohammedan win, then they will go to the semi; again, if Solid wins in the first match, then Kolkata Mohammedan will not be able to go to the semi if they don't win by a margin of 2 goals, and then Bozan will go to the semi; the poster will want Dhaka Mohammedan to play in the semi in any way.
Showing a red card and then withdrawing it again, the first in the poster's life.

There will be trolling about Abahani's loss, and it is happening; this is normal, and we troll when Mohammedan loses, that is also normal, but when Chittagong Abahani trolls us, the thing does not feel normal at all, it feels funny, because trolling needs a qualification, and that qualification has not yet become Chittagong Abahani's; winning in their own ground, in their own tournament, with players like Emily and Zahid is very easy, and yes, the poster accepts they lost, but can you say they lost to Chittagong Abahani or their players, as they lost to the patched-together players of the two brothers Jamal and Russel, and the players have taken enough 'loans', and they should have brought their own players, then we would have seen who is the best; and one more thing, the children of Chittagong say Sheikh Kamal is our founder, and we will protect his honour by winning the cup, but Sheikh Kamal is our founder, as he founded Dhaka Abahani, and from Dhaka Abahani, Chittagong Abahani was founded, so please do not insult him by calling him your founder; oh, and one more thing, no matter how many matches you win, you cannot become 'Abahani', as borrowing a few players and winning one or two matches and starting to think of yourselves as 'Abahani' is nothing but foolishness, and you are 'Chittagong' Abahani, so stay with this identity, and please do not dream of becoming 'Abahani', as the name is already booked.

In the semi, host Chittagong Abahani's opponent is Afghanistan's Bozan, and in the fight of the 2 Mohammedans, the poster wants Dhaka Mohammedan to reach the semi, and if they go to the semi, they will get East Bengal as opponent.
Goal.
Peter's goal from Faisal's corner; playing his 1st match, Peter got a goal; yes, we Dhaka Mohammedan can do it.
If Mohammedan draws, will they be able to go to the next round?

The poster cannot watch the match and is following the commentary on the page; that moment when he hears, Jibon out, Arman Aziz in; how many spectators in Chittagong today, will it be 15-20 thousand; please tell everyone to stand up a bit, as the best player of the last 10 years is entering the field; there can be many kinds of rulers, but there is only one king, King Arman Aziz, and his feet are wrapped in gold, and those who love Dhaka's football, everyone's eyes fill with tears remembering the footwork of this name; today, at least for the king, may Dhaka Mohammedan win the match.
At the last moment, Dhaka Mohammedan showed extreme play; congratulations.
Just while saying Allah, Allah, a goal.

Alhamdulillah, Dhaka Mohammedan reached the semi-final by beating Kolkata Mohammedan 2-1; yes yes yes, we Dhaka Mohammedan can do it, and in the semi, our opponent is East Bengal, and another Indian club will be given a beating again; congratulations Dhaka Mohammedan, and Dhaka means black and white.

You can avoid him, you can troll him, but you cannot keep him from scoring goals; the season's top scorer Enamul scored a goal today too, yes, General Enamul Haque, the one who holds the record of 5 goals in one match, 7 goals in 14 international matches, the architect of Bangladesh's only win in the AFC Cup, the top scorer in the 2009 SAFF, a record 21 goals in the 2012 league, 6 goals in 5 matches in the last Federation Cup, 18 goals in 23 matches last season, and the top goal scorer among Bangladeshis last season; the poster is talking about Enamul Haque, and he will be back, he will be back even stronger, just wait and see; news: on 23-10-2015, in the opening match of the Deputy Commissioner Gold Cup football tournament in Natore, Naogaon district beat Sirajganj district 3-0, with Rony scoring 2 goals for the Naogaon district team and Enamul scoring 1 goal, and Enamul of Naogaon district became man of the match.

This year, the national football team has played a total of 12 matches so far; in them, only 2 wins, 3 draws and 7 losses, with the biggest defeat 5-0 against Australia and the biggest wins 1-0 respectively against Lanka and the Thais' U-21 team; number of goals: 8 for, 22 against, and the highest scorer is Nasir Uddin Chowdhury, a defender, with 2 goals.

At the start of the tournament, there is no money, so they went down with whatever they have; they could not bring Bangoura, Jewel is sick, and the match started in this condition, and later, Sohel Rana and Mobarak joined that list, and seeing Ibrahim being taken out on a stretcher also made the poster's chest thump; due to the childish mistakes of the two central backs, they could not become group champions, but today, seeing Arman Aziz being brought on, the condition of the bench was understood, and this legend is still better than Kamara; in the next match, it will be difficult to even get 11 players, and the match is again on the 28th; the poster doesn't know when he will retire, but if this is the last tournament, Mohammedan should win the cup for this legend; and in the first half of today's match, the poster was surprised to see Joshi bhai's high-line defence, and any coach knows how much confidence it takes for this to be possible.

Today the poster will tell a history: when Bangladesh's football meant Dhaka Mohammedan and Dhaka Abahani, but with the evolution of time, today in any league of Bangladesh they become 4th or 5th, and those who never went below 1 or 2 from 1982-2005, today they are outside 1, 2 and 3, let alone becoming champions, and if tradition cannot be kept, it will not take long to disappear, and for the last few years they have not been able to show their class in any tournament; the poster doesn't know what the future will be for these 2 giants of Bangladesh, feeling the history of the past.
The poster hopes Chittagong Abahani will become champions and create football excitement in the port city of Chittagong as well as in Bangladesh.

Today the poster is 18 years old; since the age of 8, he has cherished Dhaka Mohammedan in his heart, and his mind becomes overwhelmed with joy at any of their victories; he loves Mohammedan very much, 1936-2015, 79 years old Dhaka Mohammedan, and he loves Dhaka's traditional club.
Prediction post: MSC or Chittagong Abahani will be the champion.
Jewel, get well brother, please.
Today, the poster has seen videos of goals like the last goal of the Mohammedan derby on Ten Sports and various channels, but he has never seen this type of goal live before.

According to The Daily Star: 'At the moment, they (Zahid and Emily) are not fit for the national team, it is not the job of the national team to make a professional footballer fit; however, I would try to do so if I have enough time,' said coach Fabio Lopez.

Today is Rashedul Islam bhai's birthday: former national player, Dido's favourite disciple, or Samakal's sports journalist, there is nothing new to say about him, and his biggest identity is that he taught us how to love the country's football, and if the vague matters are not clear, he is our last refuge of dependence; happy birthday bhai, 'whether the flower blooms or not, today is your birthday'.

Now it is Moreno's turn to get to work: leaving BFF's press conference room, he said in clear Bangla, 'Thank you'; due to his wife's job as an official of UNICEF Bangladesh, former Barcelona footballer Gonzalo Sanchez Moreno has been in Dhaka for five months, and in the meantime, he has also learned a little Bangla; yesterday his contract was signed with BFF as the coach of the Bangladesh youth football team, for now, a six-month contract, with a monthly salary of 2,500 dollars, and he will conduct training for footballers in a total of 70 sessions, and the coach's sponsor is SS Steel; after signing the contract, Moreno said, 'Thank you to the BFF president for keeping faith in me; my programme is very simple, I will work on each footballer's specific position, I will teach them the basics, and work on technique and tactics'; initially, he was supposed to work with the U-19 footballers, but most of the footballers of this team have contracted with various clubs, and for this reason, Moreno will train the U-16 footballers, and alongside the U-16 SAFF champions, there will be an open trial of the age-group footballers in BFF's hands, and then he will start training with 21 footballers, and the trial will be in a day or two; BFF President Kazi Salahuddin is hopeful the youth footballers' education will be good: 'After three months, this team will play international friendly matches on a home and away basis, then we will understand how much improvement has happened; I hope they will do well.'

Chittagong Abahani is probably going to be the first club in Bangladesh to fulfil all the AFC criteria; see their hope-inspiring activities: first, an AC bus has already been bought for the team, and the decision to build the club building has also been taken; second, they have decided to make an academy, and for this, they have also got the lease of Chittagong's port ground, and places for hostels and arrangements for footballers' school, food and lodging will also be made, and for the academy, U-15 footballers will be selected through trials across the country, and then they will be kept in their academy for 5-7 years and nurtured; third, they will seek the government's cooperation to install seats at the MA Aziz Stadium, and if not, they will install the seats on their own initiative, and in future, they are planning their own stadium only for Chittagong Abahani, and places are also being looked at for this; if all the above criteria are fulfilled, that will be the dream-fulfilling club for Bangladesh's football lovers; source: various press conferences and talk shows.

Interview with Saif Powertec MD Tarafdar Ruhul Amin: football must be spread all over Bangladesh, and how much response has the Sheikh Kamal International Club Cup football event created; a lot, but even if there are some questions, organiser Chittagong Abahani is fully successful, because their organisation has come like a shower of rain in the midst of a long drought, and even if this organisation created a response all over Bangladesh in this one event, one event is not everything, and critics say that to change Chittagong's football, this organisation has to be kept on the ground regularly, and organiser Chittagong Abahani also wants that, and this desire is coming through a special person from Chittagong, Tarafdar Ruhul Amin, the chief coordinator of the ongoing Sheikh Kamal International Club Cup football tournament and chairman of the football committee of organiser Chittagong Abahani; not only Chittagong, but in Bangladesh for the first time, an international football organisation by a club, this is the first time, and Chittagong Abahani is showing it; in an interview with the media during the tournament, Tarafdar Ruhul Amin said, we have very big dreams around Chittagong, and the beginning of this dream is with the Sheikh Kamal International Club Cup football tournament, and we want to spread the light of this tournament everywhere in Bangladesh, and he was telling the root story of the tournament, as the eldest son of the father of the nation Bangabandhu, the brother of the current Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, the late Sheikh Kamal was an organiser of a modern outlook in Bangladesh's sports arena, and in a short time he added many things to this country's sports arena, and with the aim of implementing his dream, when we talked about organising an international football tournament in this Chittagong, the Prime Minister immediately agreed and encouraged us greatly, and with the sincere cooperation of BFF President Kazi Salahuddin, Chittagong Mayor AJM Nasir Uddin, MP Shamsul Haque Chowdhury and all concerned with CJKC, we were able to bring down this tournament quickly; in answer to a question, Tarafdar Ruhul Amin said there is definitely social responsibility, but after taking the responsibility of Chittagong Abahani's football committee, he felt the urge to do something new, and in that context, this tournament, and the organisation is very difficult, but with everyone's sincere effort, the work could be done, and in his words, actually if the intention is right, nothing is impossible, and he talks about spreading football around instead of making it Dhaka-centric, and with the aim of taking football to a level, the ongoing tournament 2015 has been done, and this will be continued in 2016 and 2017, like this, and every year this tournament will be held, Inshallah, and we organised this tournament in a very short time, so this time we brought teams only from Pakistan, India and Sri Lanka, and next time, we will organise this tournament by bringing teams from Singapore, Thailand, Nepal and Myanmar as well, and all these organisations will take Bangladesh's football to a level, and this tournament will stay in Chittagong, expressing such an opinion, Tarafdar Ruhul Amin said, many told us to do the tournament's semi-final and final in Dhaka, but we did not agree to that, and we have a different plan around Chittagong, and after this tournament, we will take a 5-7 year project, and we will take players under 15 years, and by November we will do player hunting from this Chittagong, and we will select 40 boys and do a camp, and in academy style, we will train the boys, and in this regard, we have also written a letter seeking the port's cooperation, and we will arrange these boys' studies and food, and we will give them advanced coaching, and with world-class coaching, we will make a team, and at the time of transfers, it is generally seen that those who have money make teams with the best players, and the rest cannot do anything, and we want to change this trend, and we want to make players ourselves, and these players of ours will later play in the U-19 team, such is our target, and they will be able to play not only in our club but also in other clubs, and making players like this means creating a pipeline, and seeing this, other clubs will also come forward, they will also improve, and by that, our football system itself will improve, and he said, not only making players, through these players the club will also be able to arrange income, as is happening in Europe's professional football, and clubs have to be made earning-based, and in his words, football cannot be played by collecting donations for long, and speaking about making a modern ground and commercial complex in Halishahar on Chittagong Abahani's own land, Tarafdar Ruhul Amin said, within the next 5 years, Chittagong Abahani will be built in European style, and later, there are more plans with Chittagong Abahani, and by this, not only the club will benefit, everyone else will also benefit, and expressing again the desire that the Sheikh Kamal International Football Tournament will be in Chittagong in the future as well, Tarafdar Ruhul Amin said, our business, family and social position are all with this Chittagong, so we have a weakness for Chittagong, and at one time he was far away, but when he got the responsibility of Chittagong Abahani, he felt the urge to do something in a new style, and he wants to do something that will remain a milestone in Bangladesh's history, and this tournament is of the people of Chittagong, of the whole nation, and this is a big success, and BFF will not drop this tournament, and he prayed for the sincere cooperation of the people of Chittagong to complete this tournament successfully.
Who will win the Sheikh Kamal Cup tournament: 1 Dhaka Mohammedan, 2 Chittagong Abahani; let's see whose supporters are stronger.

Dhaka Mohammedan's trophy statistics: 11 times league champions, 10 times Independence Cup champions, 7 times international cup champions, 9 times Federation Cup champions, 2 times Super Cup champions out of 3 times, 2 times Victory Day Cup champions.
Which team's match is today?

Sohanur Rahman Mridul bhai, yesterday post in the group the matter of the strange statistics given on Emily's Wikipedia page; today the poster sees Mamunul's page is in the same condition, and he deleted it; actually, is this fun or mockery, and what do these mean; but no Bangladeshi player has correct statistics at club level, which is very sad.
In the semi, how many will Mohammedan get back after recovering from injury? Is there any problem with yellow cards? 6 people in the squad are sick; what is this?

Chittagong Abahani and Afghanistan's Bazan are both in the same condition, and both will play in the semi on the 27th; those who know, don't say anything; and East Bengal's B team, Dhaka Mohammedan's junior team, with many injured, and those who play well will play in the final.
Adidas's red-green jersey, within your reach.

Off topic, forgive the poster: he is making a football academy and club in his village, they all love football, and he is giving all the financing; he will buy jerseys for his team, so which club's plus will stand out more, and will full sleeves be available; please, if you kindly comment a picture of the jersey, he would be benefited.
And some of you thought Nepal had good talents and a bright future.
Who is the best: 1. Dhaka Mohammedan vs 2. Mohun Bagan (Kolkata); please comment.

The poster doesn't understand positions; if there is such an attacking zone, how would it be: Hemanta, Sohel, Zahid, Jibon, Jewel; speed, speed, dribbling, dribbling; uff, if only once in life he could see the Zahid-Jewel combination.
Day after tomorrow is the Mohammedan-East Bengal match; before that, a flashback.
An unfit player is unstoppable; dangerous.
Which of these two eternal rival clubs do you like: 1. Dhaka Mohammedan, 2. Dhaka Abahani; but the poster likes Dhaka Mohammedan, what a club it is, we love Dhaka Mohammedan.
Bare Fox Sports link about the Socceroos being concerned for safety ahead of the FIFA World Cup qualifier game in Bangladesh.
A wonderful report by Abu Sadat bhai.

In the 1st semi-final of the Sheikh Kamal Club Cup, Chittagong Abahani and Afghanistan's Spin Ghar Bazan FC will play; the thing that has been said about Chittagong Abahani, that they are playing with a rented team, in exactly the same way Spin Ghar Bazan FC club is playing in the tournament, as of the team that is playing in the league, not a single player of that team is in this team, and this information was given in a message on the Bangladesh Football Team page by a person from Afghanistan; anyway, the match of the 2 teams is perhaps a match of honour, and both teams will want to win and play the final of the Sheikh Kamal Club Cup organised for the first time; today at 7:40 Bangladesh time, the two teams will face each other at Chittagong's MA Aziz Stadium, and Channel 9 will show the match live; best wishes for our Chittagong Abahani.

Many are surprised about Emily and Zahid not being in the team, but the poster is not among them, as with Emily's performance, dropping him is obligatory for any coach, and you know, in football, current form is the last word, and past records are not worth a penny; now then, why is Zahid not in the team despite being in form, when there is no doubt in one word that Zahid is a very talented player, and somehow give the ball to his feet, that's it, but brother, in life the poster thinks being a polite student is more important than being a good student, and when the national team's match comes, gastric, injury, so many excuses, and when told to do fitness training, he will not do it, and he does not react according to the match situation; the poster heard from his mouth the goal of being the best player in the Bangabandhu Cup, but did not hear the goal of making the team champions, and it is said he got angry for not getting man of the match, but in life the poster has seen many wrong man of the match given, but heard in the media for the first time about getting angry like this; actually, there is no place for the ill-mannered anywhere, and you know, an empty cowshed is much better than a wicked cow.
The poster can't edit Wikipedia because he is busy.

Zahid and Emily, who set the ground on fire for Chittagong Abahani, were not taken into the national team, and as the reason, it was said they are 'mentally' and 'physically' weak; leave Emily's talk, no headache about him, but the cause of headache is Zahid, as with the performance he gave for Chittagong Abahani, he should have got a place in the team before everyone, but he did not get a place, as he is not fit; the poster saw an unfit player score a hat-trick for the first time, and what can an unfit player who scores a hat-trick do when fit; OK, leave it, why would they take an unfit player in the team; come to the psychological side, many times in a normal state people cannot work, and many writers cannot write except in a drunken state, so maybe Zahid is like that, he cannot play if not unfit; OK, this is not logic, he is definitely fit, 100% fit, and not taking him in the team is sheer foolishness; so, the poster sang Zahid's praises for so long, and now let him tell his fault: he did not join the national team showing the logic that he is unfit, so how did that same Zahid become fit in Chittagong Abahani; the question remains to your conscience.
Australia set to come to Bangladesh on 14th of November.
Goal, Abahani Chittagong ahead 1-0.
Today, seeing the spectators, the poster's heart filled up, and 20 percent of the gallery is left, and those will also be filled within a while.
Link to watch the match online? Quick!
Kingsley's goal from Thomas's pass.

Finally, those white-skinned gentlemen are coming: to play the away match of the 'Russia World Cup Football 2018' qualifiers, the Australia national football team is coming to Bangladesh on 14 November, and the match will be held at Dhaka's Bangabandhu National Stadium on 17 November, and even though they got away with not coming to play the cricket series showing the excuse of security, in football, finally they have to come, and if the Socceroos had not come to play the match, then Bangladesh might have got the full 3 points; where are ICC's rules, and where are FIFA's rules, and that is why football is called the 'Greatest Show on Earth'; bamboo is on.

Enough, past is past; come, let's think about the future, as everyone is worried about Abahani's current situation, with sky blue fans worried, as are black-and-white fans, and truly, this is Bangladesh, love for the opponent you will find only in this country, but anyway, that's off-topic, and still, heartfelt prayers for the black-and-whites; now come to the topic, everyone is dissatisfied with Abahani, me, you and everyone, and most dissatisfied are we with Abahani's management, but everything is a game of money, brother, and we need a good moneyed management, like Sheikh Russel's Bashundhara or Chittagong Abahani's Saif Powertec, and if we get a group like Beximco or Pran, then we can say 'who can stop me'; the poster's own opinion is that we need some players, like Zahid, Ibrahim, Jibon, Jewel Rana and Zia, and good foreign recruits are needed, and if we get someone of the quality of Jamal's Wedson, then he thinks some hope can be kept, and besides Amalesh sir, a coach is also needed, who will be a long-term coach, and an academy is needed, which is very easy, but no one wants to do it; the poster hopes Abahani will return this season, and for now, he expresses that hope.
Chittagong Abahani vs East Bengal, or Chittagong Abahani vs Dhaka Mohammedan: which one is it?
Winning 3-1, Chittagong Abahani are in the final; score: Kingsley 2, Thomas 1; assists: Hemanta 1, Emily 1; congratulations Chittagong Abahani.
Good news: among the local coaches of this time, one of the best coaches, Maruful Haque, has passed the exam of a UEFA licence-holder coach; congratulations to Maruful Haque.

As the first coach of South Asia, Maruful Haque succeeded in the UEFA A coaching; 'let birth be anywhere, let work be good', he made true that important sentence from the expansion read in childhood, and whatever his playing career, in whatever smallest country of the world he was born, he has amazed South Asia; good luck boss, the only treble-winning coach in the country's history.

so can you now be called a Bangladeshi, and hearing the question as soon as he woke up on the morning after the final, Kingsley laughed and said, 'I have married in Bangladesh, I think of myself from the heart as one of this country; until I get Bangladesh's citizenship, of course I will go by Nigerian identity; I will apply for Bangladesh's citizenship after some more days; but yes, you can say this, I am now half Nigerian, half Bangladeshi, ha-ha!'

88 goals in 6 matches, Sabina's 10; calling the third day of the KFC National Women's Championship a goal-flood day would be an understatement; in 6 matches, 'only' 88 goals were scored, almost 15 goals per match; the biggest margin was in Meherpur, where BJMC washed away Chuadanga 26-0; Ansar and VDP were no less, as in Lakshmipur, they put the ball in Noakhali's net 25 times (25-0); the day was enjoyed most by national team striker Sabina Khatun; 'goal machine' Sabina has the experience of scoring 14-15 goals in one match many times, and yesterday, in BJMC's jersey, she did comparatively less, 'only' 10; teammate Mirna's 5 and Suraiya's 4 goals; there were hat-tricks by Mukta and Bithi too; in the Lakshmipur match, Munmun and Uching Marma scored the highest 7 goals each; Maoi Marma has 6 goals beside her name; in Rajshahi, in Tangail's 15-0 win against Sirajganj, Krishnarani scored 6 goals, and Mithila scored 4; in Faridpur, with Sadia's hat-trick, Gopalganj washed away Munshiganj 9-0; in Rangpur, in Thakurgaon's 8-0 win against Panchagarh, Baby Rani scored 6 goals; in Jessore, with Parvin's hat-trick, Satkhira easily beat Bagerhat (4-1).

Chittagong Abahani Limited's plan to reshape football in Chittagong: 'The metropolitan sports association has been organising the Pioneer football tournament with children for a long time; I will reshape this tournament anew, so that children become more interested in football'; 'I will form a team with former players who played in the national league and form a coaching team for children; that team will train children in turns, so that their careers are built'; 'On the model of BFF or the district sports association, U-14 and U-16 teams will be formed and trained; they will be given the opportunity to participate in various tournaments; similarly, for the youth, U-18 and U-19 football teams will be formed and training arranged; if we stay in football throughout the year like this, a result will definitely come' — former national footballer and sports association vice-president Ashish Bhadra.
