incidents.summary: A video on the national team's syndicate circulates, and Zahid Hassan Emily admits in a video that when officials gave him team-building responsibility he picked Mamunul Islam and Jahid Hasan Ameli.

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings release foreign players and withhold local salaries for three months
incidents.summary: After the BPL is cancelled, Bashundhara Kings bid farewell to Daniel Colindres and other foreign players and have not paid local players a single taka of salary in nearly three months.

incidents.title: Ekattor TV reports on BFF corruption; BFF protest and Shohag at the centre
incidents.summary: Ekattor TV's Khelajog reports on BFF corruption and general secretary Abu Nayeem Shohag, BFF protest the reports, and fans note nearly a hundred earlier letters to FIFA led to no action.

incidents.title: Salahuddin asks the government for 40 crore and gets nothing
incidents.summary: Salahuddin is mocked for wanting 40 crore from the budget and being handed nothing, which gives his election opponents oxygen.

incidents.title: BFF fake IDs and a bot army attack critics online
incidents.summary: Fans allege BFF staff run fake IDs, a 'Dog Squad' and a bot army that counter-attack anyone who criticises the federation on Facebook.

incidents.title: Row over a league without foreign players
incidents.summary: Suggested new category: foreign-player policy row. Tarafder Ruhul Amin proposes a league without foreigners for four years, seven of ten clubs later agree not to play foreigners, and fans protest that no other league is doing this.

incidents.title: National-team selection rows: the syndicate, interference and the 36-man squad
incidents.summary: Fans ask how Joseph Rahman sat out from 2016 to 2017, why Hamza Choudhury and Emon Mahmud are not called up, and why Rahmatganj players are overlooked while others interfere in selecting the XI.

incidents.title: COVID-19 outbreak in the national-team camp
incidents.summary: Suggested new category: covid camp outbreak. Seven more players and a coach test COVID positive in the national-team camp, bringing the total to 18 players and one coach, with the Police FC coach questioning the test results.

incidents.title: Salahuddin promises the 2026 World Cup and faces renewed removal calls
incidents.summary: Salahuddin says Bangladesh cannot play the 2022 World Cup but will definitely play in 2026 if he becomes president again, as fans renew calls to remove him.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu National Stadium in poor condition, vegetables grown on it
incidents.summary: Fans point out Uganda has better-quality stadiums while Bangladesh has only one stadium in poor condition, and later note vegetables are being grown at Bangabandhu Stadium instead of football.

incidents.title: BFF election: vote-buying, broken 2016 manifesto and intimidation of rivals
incidents.summary: Ahead of the BFF election, fans allege vote-buying with five-star hotel events and cash-or-flat offers, note 20 of 25 promises in the 2016 manifesto went unfulfilled, and report a GD against general secretary Abu Nayeem Shohag for threatening Badal Roy.

incidents.title: Salahuddin Out movement: human chains at the Press Club and across districts
incidents.summary: Fans hold a human chain at the National Press Club on 14 September and in districts across the country, demanding Salahuddin's removal after 12 years, after he calls the protesters street boys.

incidents.title: Coach Oscar Bruzon campaigns in Bangla for a BFF election candidate
incidents.summary: Spanish coach Oscar Bruzon, who cannot even speak English well, writes in Bangla on his own timeline asking for votes for a candidate in the BFF election.

incidents.title: BFF spent 120-124 crore on football development with nothing to show
incidents.summary: Per Ekattor TV, BFF spent 120 crore taka on football development from 2016-2020, and fans ask how 124 crore was spent while Salahuddin begs the media for swimming-pool money.

incidents.title: BFF send a legal notice to a protester; later a legal notice against 12 supporters
incidents.summary: BFF send a legal notice against a protester instead of the officials whose deeds damage the country's image, and in November a supporter serves a legal notice against 12 football supporters with Bashundhara Kings as main patron.

incidents.title: BFF election 2020: Salahuddin re-elected to a fourth term amid vote-buying claims
incidents.summary: Salahuddin wins a fourth term with nearly 67 percent of delegates' votes though he gets under 5 percent in public votes, as fans allege councillors were bought with five-star hotel stays and a crore-taka Sonargaon bill and an intelligence report alleges corruption in the Prime Minister's name.

incidents.title: Federation Cup champions' prize money stuck at 5 lakh year after year
incidents.summary: Suggested new category: prize money stagnation. Fans ask whether the Federation Cup champions' prize will again be a beggarly 5 lakh, and mock BFF for keeping it at 5 lakh year after year.

incidents.title: Ataur Rahman Manik's youth projects: the over-8 project and a rented house for 100 age-group players
incidents.summary: Suggested new category: bogus youth project. Fans mock Ataur Rahman Manik's over-8 football project and his claim of renting a whole house to keep 100 age-group footballers under watch.

incidents.title: Injured and unfit players kept in the national squad
incidents.summary: Officials invite injured or bench-warming players to the national-team camp, keep two footballers in the main team though they will not get fit soon against Nepal, and take Mamunul Islam with a cracked hand to Qatar.

incidents.title: COVID-19 in the Nepal camp as quarantine is relaxed for the friendlies
incidents.summary: Suggested new category: covid friendly series. Four Nepal players are infected before the Bangladesh match while quarantine is relaxed for the tour, and eight Nepal players are infected in total.

incidents.title: Club grounds and buildings neglected
incidents.summary: Mohammedan's ground is uncut and uneven, Abahani practise on a surface like a Dhanmondi road, Brothers Union's building looks abandoned, and fans say BFF is indifferent about good grounds.

incidents.title: Ticket black-marketing during the Bangladesh-Nepal series
incidents.summary: Ticket sellers outside Bangabandhu Stadium never run out even when the stadium exceeds capacity, with black marketeers said to work in collusion with federation secretary Barkat and the national captain's social media manager named as a black marketeer.

incidents.title: Qatar preparation matches arranged against weak opponents
incidents.summary: Bangladesh are given the Qatar Army team and second-tier Lusail instead of the two Qatar Stars League teams requested, and lose 3-2 to the Army team.

incidents.title: Jamie Day on holiday in England as reports say he is about to be sacked
incidents.summary: Coach Jamie Day is reported to be about to be sacked while he holidays in England, with fans noting he mostly sits in England instead of watching domestic league matches.

incidents.title: Academies accredited without inspection; Academy Cup best player from the federation's own circle
incidents.summary: BFF register most academies without inspection under its accreditation scheme, and the best player of the Academy Cup is selected from the federation's own circle.

incidents.title: Women's league: Sabina Khatun gets 5,000 taka and a dummy cheque as top scorer
incidents.summary: Sabina Khatun gets 5,000 taka and a dummy cheque for scoring the most goals in the women's league, while Bashundhara Kings pay her 3 lakh and Tohura Khatun 2 lakh, and fans demand the league standard be raised.

incidents.title: Brothers Union collapse: no coach, no transfers, players eat at an unhygienic hotel
incidents.summary: Suggested new category: historic club collapse. Brothers Union fail to complete transfers in time, have no coach, players warm up themselves for the Federation Cup and eat at a local unhygienic hotel, with darkness inside and outside the club.

incidents.title: Shahjahan Ahmed Sujon fights for his life after his kidneys fail
incidents.summary: Suggested new category: player welfare neglect. Former Rahmatganj player Shahjahan Ahmed Sujon, who fell ill after playing in 2016-17 and whose kidneys failed, is fighting for his life while teammates run around the field.

incidents.title: Lenient bans for abusing referees; Taklis sent off for pushing an opponent
incidents.summary: Fans condemn one-match bans for players who raised hands on referees as encouragement rather than deterrent, after Taklis was sent off for pushing an opponent.

incidents.title: T-Sports broadcast and commentary quality attacked by fans
incidents.summary: Fans attack T-Sports' unqualified commentators, bad camera angles, missing replays and uneven televising of matches. Suggested new category: broadcast_quality.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Stadium pitch ruined; BFF drops Narsingdi venue without inspection
incidents.summary: The Bangabandhu Stadium pitch is ruined with six Federation Cup matches still to play, and BFF drops Narsingdi's Mosleh Uddin Bhuiyan Stadium as a venue without proper inspection.

incidents.title: Oscar Bruzon accused of unprofessional conduct off the pitch
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings coach Oscar Bruzon is accused of messaging a critical fan on Facebook and attending fan events during Covid instead of focusing on coaching. Suggested new category: coach_conduct.

incidents.title: Federation Cup semi-final refereeing row: Kings beat Abahani amid disputed offside/foul calls
incidents.summary: Kings beat Abahani in the Federation Cup semi-final amid disputed offside and foul calls; fans demand an investigation into the linesman's decisions.

incidents.title: BFF men seize archery ground and scold archery officials
incidents.summary: Fans allege BFF men acting like local goons seized the archery ground and scolded archery officials.

incidents.title: Kolkata Mohammedan players boycott practice over unpaid salaries
incidents.summary: Kolkata Mohammedan players boycott practice over salary issues, souring captain Jamal Bhuyan's I-League move.

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings bench national-team players, ruining their careers
incidents.summary: Fans accuse Bashundhara Kings of ruining national-team players' careers by benching them, naming Matin Mia, Robiul Hasan and Atiqur Rahman Fahad and calling for loans.

incidents.title: Refereeing accused of favouring Bashundhara Kings
incidents.summary: A run of BPL decisions — denied penalties, Topu Barman's dive, referee Jalal's handball call, Saif denied a penalty vs Kings — fuels claims referees favour Bashundhara Kings.

incidents.title: BFF's BPL organisation failures and mocked VAR promise
incidents.summary: Fans mock Salam Murshedy's promise of VAR from next season while the BPL has low-quality replica balls, no coverage of the Championship League and no proper broadcast or promotion.

incidents.title: Match-fixing and spot-fixing allegations against Arambagh and Brothers Union
incidents.summary: BFF sends letters to Arambagh and Brothers Union over match-fixing and spot-fixing allegations, including online-betting claims; fans demand punishment, while the match-fixing committee's term is found to have expired.

incidents.title: Player pay exploitation: tiny salaries, syndicate cuts, stars forced abroad
incidents.summary: A Championship League scorer gets no team on a season wage of 20,000 taka with syndicate cuts, a U-14 captain leaves to work abroad as a labourer, and Sabbir is offered 3 lakh after 20 lakh the previous season; Nepal's champions spend less than Jamal and Matin's combined salaries.

incidents.title: Bangabandhu Stadium pitch worst ever; fans demand Bermuda grass at every BPL ground
incidents.summary: Fans call the Bangabandhu Stadium pitch the worst ever seen this season and demand Bermuda grass at every BPL ground, with the league committee taking over grounds two months early.

incidents.title: Referees accused of denying Mohammedan a clear penalty
incidents.summary: Fans accuse referees of denying Mohammedan a clear penalty and officiating 'drunk', saying referees are now sold to clubs.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal's 2012 AFC Presidents Cup withdrawal recalled as shameful precedent
incidents.summary: Fans recall Sheikh Jamal setting a shameful precedent by withdrawing from the 2012 AFC Presidents Cup, with Muktijoddha refused as a replacement, alongside an accusation Jamal fixed Muktijoddha out of a title.

incidents.title: Rimon vs Yasin: selection row over makeshift left-back and 'syndicate' hype
incidents.summary: Fans erupt over Rimon Hossain being picked and started at left-back ahead of experienced Yasin Arafat, alleging a 'syndicate' and a 'Linkon gang' hype him into the national team.

incidents.title: Expatriate Bangladeshi players overlooked by Jamie Day
incidents.summary: Fans ask why expatriate players — Johnny, Khatan, Joseph Nur Rahman, Das, Karim and Jeremy Faruqi — never get national-team chances, while Afghanistan snaps up diaspora talent like Hossein Zamani.

incidents.title: Three Nations Cup farce: only goal in 270 minutes is an own goal
incidents.summary: Across the Three Nations Cup's three matches (270 minutes) the only goal is an own goal by Kyrgyzstan U23's Kumar Baj Ulu Baiaman.

incidents.title: Nepal tri-nation final defeat: Jamie Day's selection and tactics blamed
incidents.summary: Bangladesh lose the Nepal tri-nation final 2-1 and fans blame Jamie Day's short-sighted squad, experimental XI and negative approach; he then skips the post-match press conference and faces an ANFA show-cause notice.

incidents.title: Salahuddin's 12 years in power attacked; cricket-board boast mocked
incidents.summary: Fans lament 12 years of Salahuddin's power with no academy while Nepal builds one, and mock his claim that as cricket-board president he would make Bangladesh a top-two team.

incidents.title: FIFA stops funding BFF over spending irregularities
incidents.summary: FIFA stops funding BFF over irregularities in spending FIFA money; the federation claims FIFA only urged more transparency and no suspension happened.

incidents.title: Covid league-restart chaos: second leg delayed, clubs unready
incidents.summary: With Covid, the league's second leg may not restart before May, the promised seven days after lockdown pass, and several clubs are not ready when the restart is set.

incidents.title: Eleta Kingsley's registration blocked at the last moment
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings learn the night before a match that Eleta Kingsley, newly a Bangladeshi citizen, is not eligible to play despite the Players' Status Committee declaring his registration form valid subject to papers.

incidents.title: Abahani dropped from AFC Cup; Group D postponed amid Covid-bubble rows
incidents.summary: Abahani are removed from the AFC Cup for failing to host the playoff, then Group D is postponed; Kings allege the postponement was planned to help Covid-hit Indian sides and demand Bengaluru and ATK Mohun Bagan be removed.

incidents.title: No proper stadium or practice ground: Brothers Union train on bare ground
incidents.summary: Brothers Union, a professional team, practise on a bare ground, and fans ask why BFF does not have even one proper stadium.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan abused online over 'Original Ronaldo' post
incidents.summary: Locals abuse captain Jamal Bhuyan online for calling Brazilian Ronaldo the 'Original Ronaldo', a description FIFA itself has used; fans defend him as the country's asset.

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings delay releasing players to the national camp
incidents.summary: Kings initially refuse to release players to the national camp until quarantine arrangements in Qatar and Bangladesh are clear; BFF implicitly threatens them before the players are released at the president's request.

incidents.title: World Cup qualifier preparation failure: no friendlies, no foreign camp
incidents.summary: Fans condemn BFF for sending Bangladesh into the June World Cup qualifiers with a makeshift 10-day Dhaka camp and no preparation matches while Nepal, Afghanistan, India and Oman all play friendlies abroad.

incidents.title: World Cup qualifier refereeing: three wrong decisions vs Afghanistan
incidents.summary: Fans say three wrong decisions in 100 minutes, including a denied penalty, marred Bangladesh's World Cup qualifier against Afghanistan.

incidents.title: World Cup qualifiers fallout: fans demand Jamie Day be sacked
incidents.summary: After defeats to Afghanistan, India and Oman, fans demand Jamie Day be sacked over defensive long-ball tactics, wrong substitutions, the Rimon-at-right-back experiment and claims about Bangladesh's points record.

incidents.title: Obaidur Rahman Nobab and Eleta Kingsley left out of Qatar squad
incidents.summary: Obaidur Rahman Nobab, scorer of a brace in a friendly after Qatar U23 experience, gets no place in the Qatar squad for not yet proving himself in the BPL, and fans say Jamie Day will have nightmares watching him and Eleta.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan stripped of the national-team captaincy
incidents.summary: Jamal Bhuyan is relieved of the captaincy before the Oman match, ending his run as captain through the team's anxious transition period.

incidents.title: Jamal Bhuyan quarantine-violation row; fans suspect it was staged
incidents.summary: A poster who criticised Jamal Bhuyan's quarantine violation later suspects the incident was intentionally staged against Jamal for speaking out against BFF over World Cup qualifier preparation.

incidents.title: BFF and syndicates blamed for football's decline: no academy, no ground
incidents.summary: Fans blame BFF and syndicates for having no quality international ground and no academy, saying money for the game will not help while syndicates control it.

incidents.title: Oscar Bruzon benches Tariq and Nawab at Bashundhara Kings
incidents.summary: Fans accused Kings coach Oscar Bruzon of benching expatriates Tariq Kazi and Obaidur Rahman Nawab despite their national-team form, dismissing Obaid as unproven at senior level; the benching row ran from June into August 2021 as supporters said even a banana tree could coach Kings to the title.

incidents.title: Tariq Kazi red card: referee Jalal Uddin accused of covering his own errors
incidents.summary: Tariq Kazi is sent off in the 87th minute vs Rahmatganj and fans say referee Jalal Uddin made him the scapegoat for his own errors, also depriving Sheikh Jamal of a win; Rahmatganj formally protest to BFF.

incidents.title: Journalist's racist 'Africans fight' remark condemned
incidents.summary: Fans demand a journalist be judged and banned from journalism for a racist remark about Africans, in a row also targeting Oscar Bruzon's defender. Suggested new category: racist_remark_in_media.

incidents.title: Refereeing rows hit the BPL
incidents.summary: Fans flagged unpunished two-footed tackles and a face-hit with no card, and questioned BFF punishments after players argued with referees.

incidents.title: BPL suspended amid muddy pitches and Kamalapur turf row
incidents.summary: Rain turned Bangabandhu Stadium into mud and the BPL was repeatedly suspended, with BFF then forcing matches onto Kamalapur's broken turf.

incidents.title: Fans demand Salahuddin and Murshedi resign
incidents.summary: A wave of posts demanded BFF president Kazi Salahuddin and league committee chairman Salam Murshedi quit after 12 years of failure.

incidents.title: Mohammedan expel Robiul for repeated indiscipline
incidents.summary: Mohammedan expelled Robiul after repeated show-cause notices and a further breach of discipline on 14 June.

incidents.title: Ariful Islam's unpaid wages end in suicide attempt
incidents.summary: Former national captain Ariful Islam, unpaid by Sheikh Jamal and Sheikh Russel for two seasons, attempted suicide; his wife said Sheikh Jamal paid not even 1% of his 2020 contract.

incidents.title: Fortis accuse Swadhinata of match-fixing
incidents.summary: Fortis FC complained to BFF that Swadhinata Krira Sangha fixed matches against Youngmen's and Dhaka City, costing Fortis the title.

incidents.title: Women's football grants questioned
incidents.summary: Fans asked where FIFA's 1.2 crore taka women's allocation went as teenage talents quit, and questioned the women's team manager's reappointment.

incidents.title: Six nations reject BFF friendly proposals
incidents.summary: Afghanistan, Bhutan, Laos, Cambodia, Maldives and Macau all rejected BFF proposals for September FIFA friendlies, leaving Bangladesh with no preparation.

incidents.title: Oscar's Kings flop out of the AFC Cup
incidents.summary: Bashundhara Kings exited the AFC Cup group stage with 5 points instead of the targeted 7, and fans asked whether Oscar Bruzon should keep his job.

incidents.title: Match-day ambulance and medical facilities condemned
incidents.summary: Fans condemned the state of ambulances and medical cover at league matches.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal sack coach Manik hours before a match
incidents.summary: Sheikh Jamal sacked coach Shafiqul Islam Manik three hours before a league match, the fourth such sacking in the club's history, sparking fixing suspicions.

incidents.title: Stadium and pitch neglect: Kamalapur turf and Bangabandhu
incidents.summary: Fans attacked BFF for playing on Kamalapur's dangerous turf, the national stadium's poor pitch, and Salahuddin's stadium-complex plan instead of a new ground.

incidents.title: Jamie Day's squad snubs in-form players
incidents.summary: Fans showed league stats to argue Jamie Day ignored in-form players like Faisal Fahim while auto-picking underperforming regulars.

incidents.title: Arambagh relegated and banned for match-fixing
incidents.summary: Arambagh KS were relegated and their officials and players banned after a match-fixing investigation, ending the club's top-flight stay.

incidents.title: Brothers Union collapse while its officials run BFF
incidents.summary: Historic Brothers Union were relegated for the first time in 46 years while three of its officials sat on the BFF committee running the country's football.

incidents.title: Elita Kingsley's clearance failure blocks SAFF selection
incidents.summary: Five months after Elita Kingsley got Bangladeshi citizenship, BFF still had no FIFA clearance for him, and Salahuddin said the federation would not chase it; Elita missed the SAFF.

incidents.title: Former captain Aminul Islam attacked
incidents.summary: Fans condemned and protested an attack on legendary former national captain and goalkeeper Aminul Islam. [Suggested new category: assault_on_football_personnel.]

incidents.title: Syndicate and commission allegations: Rupu, Abahani and BFF
incidents.summary: Fans alleged commission business in signings, Abahani's Rupu enriching himself through old players, and a football mafia running the game.

incidents.title: BFF blocks fan comments while FIFA and AFC keep theirs open
incidents.summary: Fans noted FIFA and AFC leave their Facebook pages open to harsh fan criticism while BFF blocks supporters from commenting.

incidents.title: Sheikh Jamal players fight spectators and get banned
incidents.summary: Sheikh Jamal players fought with spectators after a match against Brothers Union; two footballers were banned.

incidents.title: Uttar Baridhara accused of match-fixing
incidents.summary: Fans accused Uttar Baridhara of fixing after they released all foreigners once relegation was avoided and conceded a suspicious first goal.

incidents.title: Jamuna TV accused of smearing expatriate Shoron Khan
incidents.summary: Fans condemned a Jamuna TV report on Canada-based Shoron Khan as a conspiracy, saying it used futsal footage to imply he was not a real player. [Suggested new category: media_smear_of_player.]

incidents.title: Ex-Kings official Minhaz accused of fixing and betting
incidents.summary: Fans alleged former Bashundhara Kings general secretary Minhazul Minhaz was involved in fixing and betting in the Championship League, with 12-13 matches fixed and no BFF investigation.

incidents.title: Oscar Bruzon handed the national team; Rupu made manager
incidents.summary: Oscar Bruzon was put in charge of the national team for the SAFF with Satyajit Das Rupu as manager, amid claims the syndicate picked its own coach and a satirical rumour Oscar demanded Robson's citizenship.

incidents.title: SAFF squad: expatriates frozen out
incidents.summary: Fans accused the BFF and coaches of freezing expatriates and naturalised players out of the SAFF squad while auto-picking underperforming locals, with 20 of 27 preliminary squad players from Bashundhara.

incidents.title: Women's team decline and Kiran's travel spending
incidents.summary: The women's team lost 5-0 to Jordan and Iran while fans attacked the coaching and alleged women's wing head Mahfuza Akhter Kiran spent heavily on foreign trips as the league shut down.

incidents.title: Players accused of fake IDs and arguing with fans
incidents.summary: Fans accused so-called professional players of arguing with supporters and running fake IDs to oppose expatriate players.

incidents.title: Fans' sit-in and protest movement against Salahuddin
incidents.summary: Fans called sit-ins at the BFF building and the PM's office, threatened to drag Salahuddin out if the SAFF failed, and demanded cases against him; the movement carried on after the SAFF exit.

incidents.title: Super League proposal blocked by officials
incidents.summary: Fans blamed power-hungry officials for blocking the proposed Bangladesh Super League, saying clubs share as much blame as the BFF.

incidents.title: Age fraud alleged across youth and national teams
incidents.summary: A long post alleged age fraud in Bangladesh football, citing youth captains and claiming national players are far older than listed.

incidents.title: Expatriates still frozen out for four-nation and U23
incidents.summary: Fans demanded Nawab, Rahbar, Mahdi, Yousuf, Riasat and Tariq be picked, citing passport excuses, fitness lies and kickbacks, as the U23s lost 6-0 to Uzbekistan without them.

incidents.title: SAFF 2021: group-stage exit with no open-play goal
incidents.summary: Bangladesh exited the SAFF group stage scoring only three set-piece goals in four matches, and fans blamed Salahuddin and the BFF for a sixth straight group-stage exit under him.

incidents.title: Elita's clearance still pending after the SAFF
incidents.summary: Seven months after Elita Kingsley got his passport, BFF still had not secured his international clearance, and fans demanded him for the Sri Lanka four-nation tournament.

incidents.title: SAFF tickets sold in black at three times the price
incidents.summary: Fans reported only 10% of Bangladesh-Maldives SAFF tickets went to Bangladeshis, with the rest sold in black at three times the price.

incidents.title: BFF mocked for lavish Tariq birthday cake
incidents.summary: Fans mocked the national team celebrating Tariq Kazi's birthday with an unnecessarily big cake as BFF waste while football starved.

incidents.title: Refereeing rows at the SAFF and in the league
incidents.summary: Fans protested a cancelled onside Sri Lanka goal, a biased SAFF referee, and Zico's red card for handling outside the box.

incidents.title: Oscar out, Lemos in: the Rupu loop continues
incidents.summary: Oscar Bruzon would not coach the four-nation tournament and Mario Lemos took over, but fans said the Oscar-Rupu loop had simply become Lemos-Rupu.

incidents.title: Player publicly calls a teammate brainless
incidents.summary: Fans attacked a player who publicly called a teammate brainless, reminding him of his own mistakes that let Sunil Chhetri score twice.

incidents.title: National players play khep exhibition matches
incidents.summary: Fans mocked national players for playing paid local exhibition (khep) matches on rest days, while one player did it to pay for his sick mother's treatment after the club refused to pay. [Suggested new category: khep_exhibition_matches.]

incidents.title: Players silently protest BFF's relentless camps
incidents.summary: Fans suggested players were silently protesting BFF's relentless camps, with barely any rest in a year and 15-day camps without international matches. [Suggested new category: player_welfare_camp_conditions.]

incidents.title: Goalkeeping coach Nayan beaten in Mirpur
incidents.summary: Goalkeeping coach Nuruzzaman Nayan was badly beaten by a motorcyclist and five or six others in Mirpur, and fans demanded justice and punishment for the attackers. [Suggested new category: assault_on_team_staff.]

incidents.title: Expatriates benched and overlooked into December
incidents.summary: Fans kept asking why expatriates like Tariq, Nawab, Elita and Riasat sat on the bench or were dropped while locals crowded into Bashundhara Kings.

incidents.title: Four-nation tournament failure in Sri Lanka
incidents.summary: Bangladesh's four-nation campaign in Sri Lanka ended in defeat to Sri Lanka and a draw with Seychelles, which fans called poetic justice for the syndicate.

incidents.title: Mohammedan coach accused of blocking signings for commission
incidents.summary: Fans claimed Mohammedan could not sign good foreigners because the coach, backed by committee ex-players, blocked deals amid commission business.

incidents.title: Journalist: Salahuddin asks for money, football will never rise
incidents.summary: A post quoted Ekattor TV journalist Upal Nandi saying Bangladesh football will never rise above this level, with Salahuddin asking for money.

incidents.title: T Sports accused of Kings-only biased coverage
incidents.summary: Fans accused T Sports of broadcasting only on Bashundhara Kings' match days with commentary that only talked about Kings and Robinho. [Suggested new category: media_bias.]

incidents.title: Stadiums and academies: Zimbabwe and Myanmar ahead
incidents.summary: Fans contrasted Zimbabwe's stadiums and Myanmar's three football academies with Bangladesh, asking how far BFF's FIFA-funded academy work had gone.

incidents.title: National team has no salary or match fee
incidents.summary: Fans asked why players go to play when clubs splash money but the national team has no salary or match fee.

incidents.title: Tariq treated like a dog, Vranjes comparison
incidents.summary: A long post compared Bosnian Stojan Vranjes with Tariq Kazi and accused the syndicate of treating Tariq like a dog in club and national team.

incidents.title: Only 2 of 9 clubs get AFC licences
incidents.summary: Nepal and Bhutan got 4 AFC licences each while Bangladesh got only 2 of 9 applicants, with fans arguing most of the money goes out through various holes.

incidents.title: Heavy defeats expose the state of football
incidents.summary: After heavy defeats including a six-goal loss, fans said the days of beating Sri Lanka to save face were over and services teams exposed the national game's state. [Suggested new category: on_field_decline.]

incidents.title: Bashundhara Kings lawyer notice and BFF verdict questioned
incidents.summary: Fans asked what happened to the lawyer notice and BFF's verdict, or whether Bashundhara Kings quietly settled after joking in newspapers.

incidents.title: Elita still without clearance into December
incidents.summary: Into December, Elita Kingsley still had no international clearance and fans kept asking when he would wear the red-green jersey.

incidents.title: Kamalapur turf blamed for player injuries
incidents.summary: Fans blamed Kamalapur's discarded turf for ligament injuries to Topu, Tariq, Elita and Nawab, and backed Kings refusing to play on it.

incidents.title: Rabiul's talent destroyed by drug addiction
incidents.summary: Fans traced Rabiul's fall from Arambagh to Kings' bench to expulsion from Mohammedan, asking why drug addiction destroys such talent.

incidents.title: Oscar must go: December calls to sack him
incidents.summary: After the Independence Cup, fans demanded Kings change Oscar Bruzon, saying he wronged Nawab and Elita and wasted the squad's potential.

incidents.title: Kings accused of buying referees in the Independence Cup
incidents.summary: Fans accused Bashundhara Kings of buying the league committee and referees after a denied Sheikh Jamal penalty, a wrongly flagged Sharifi offside, and Sharifi gesturing about money to the referee.

incidents.title: U-17 age discrepancy: Anik Deb
incidents.summary: Fans pointed out an age discrepancy: viral Sylhet goalscorer Anik Deb was said to be over 18 yet played in an U-17 tournament.

incidents.title: BFF vice-president sits with a club's flag
incidents.summary: Fans asked in which country's federation a vice-president sits with a specific team's flag and supporters watching a domestic match.

incidents.title: Club domination of the federation and the power balance
incidents.summary: Fans argued club domination of federation posts and corruption drag football back, and that Abahani's Independence Cup final win over Kings shifted the power balance.

incidents.title: Police snatch SYNDICATE OUT banners at the stadium
incidents.summary: Police and suited men snatched fans' SYNDICATE OUT banners within minutes at the stadium, and fans called for protest banners at the final.

incidents.title: Mohammedan and Swadhinata called back from buses for a tie-breaker
incidents.summary: Mohammedan and Swadhinata were called back from their buses for a tie-breaker after a 1-1 draw, with Mohammedan winning 4-3.

incidents.title: Saif and Bashundhara urged to defy BFF with a Super League
incidents.summary: Fans said Saif and Bashundhara should defy BFF and implement the dream Bangladesh Super League, as UEFA defied FIFA.
